9月7日公告说明社区倡议可申请1000—3500欧元，安排10月5日09:00开: The 7 September announcement offered EUR 1,000–3,500 for community initiatives, scheduled opening at 09:00 on 5 October, and warned of a limited budget.
格罗宁根：省道噪声上限草案征求意见: Groningen: consultation on draft provincial-road noise ceilings
省政府已计算约1万个点位的省道噪声，拟设噪声增长上限；公众意见期至11月18日。: The province has calculated road noise at roughly 10,000 points and proposes ceilings on its growth; comments are invited through 18 November.
旧噪声法的保护不覆盖交通量自然增长；《环境法》要求引入对这种增长的控制。: The former noise law did not protect against autonomous traffic growth; the Environment and Planning Act requires controls covering that growth.
草案以计算值增加1.5分贝作为上限空间，官方说明约对应40%的交通增长。每年监测: The draft allows a 1.5 dB margin above calculated levels, described by the province as roughly equivalent to 40% traffic growth. Monitoring is annual, with five-year reporting and measures proposed when ceilings are exceeded.
省道附近居民、道路管理者以及受道路噪声影响的开发项目。: Residents near provincial roads, road managers and development affected by road noise.
这是上限草案，并不立即降低现有噪声。措施社会成本过高时可能调整上限；具体点位和计: These are draft ceilings, not an immediate reduction in existing noise. Ceilings may be adjusted if mitigation has excessive societal costs; consult the formal draft for point-specific calculations. The announced year-end calculation/publication requirement does not establish final adoption at every point.
已核对公告正文；本条区分计划、申请、拨款和法规阶段。: Announcement text checked; this explanation distinguishes plans, applications, awards and legal stages.
格罗宁根：环境条例草案涉及历史建筑、电池储能和乡村用途: Groningen: draft environmental ordinance covers historic buildings, battery storage and rural uses
新省级环境条例草案从10月6日至11月16日征求意见，拟落实已通过的新环境愿景；: A new provincial environmental ordinance is open for comments from 6 October to 16 November to implement the adopted environmental vision; a provincial assembly decision is expected in February 2027.
省已有环境条例；新环境愿景及全国规则要求调整省级实施规则。: The province already has an environmental ordinance; the new vision and national legislation require changes to implementing rules.
拟要求市镇也清点保护地震区外聚落的特色建筑，大型电池储能仅设于工业园，并在条件下: Municipalities would also inventory and protect characteristic buildings in settlements outside the earthquake area. Large battery storage would be limited to industrial estates, while rural hospitality and day recreation would gain conditional scope.
市镇、水务机构、特色建筑业主、储能开发者及乡村经营者。: Municipalities, water authorities, characteristic-building owners, storage developers and rural businesses.
9月29日批准的是征询草案，不是最终条例。多数规则约束公共机关，部分直接影响居民: The 29 September approval concerns the consultation draft, not the final ordinance. Most rules address public authorities, with some directly affecting residents and businesses; parcel-specific rules, exceptions and permits require the draft and final decision.
格罗宁根：逾200万欧元支持19项道路安全工程: Groningen: over EUR 2 million for 19 road-safety projects
省政府公布向市镇19项道路安全工程拨款逾200万欧元，包括限速30公里路段、学校: The province announced over EUR 2 million for 19 municipal road-safety projects, including 30 km/h streets, school surroundings and cycling routes.
省连续第四年通过道路安全战略支持市镇项目，目标是2030年交通伤亡较2020年减: This is the fourth consecutive year of municipal support under the road-safety strategy, which targets halving casualties by 2030 relative to 2020.
本批7个项目涉及城区30公里限速，3个市镇获学校周边措施补助。省级补助最高覆盖5: Seven projects concern urban 30 km/h limits, and three municipalities receive school-area support. Provincial grants cover up to 50%; municipalities must implement the projects before 2031.
有关市镇的行人、骑车者、学生、驾驶人及道路管理部门。: Pedestrians, cyclists, pupils, drivers and road managers in the municipalities concerned.
这是指定工程拨款，不是全省道路统一改为30公里，也不是居民现金补贴。具体位置及工: These are awards for identified projects, not a province-wide 30 km/h limit or household cash grant. Locations and individual amounts require the project map; construction timing is project-specific.
格罗宁根：两年32万欧元支持代际贫困家庭帮扶: Groningen: EUR 320,000 over two years for support tackling intergenerational poverty
省政府未来两年投入32万欧元支持Alliantie van Kracht的代际贫: The province is investing EUR 320,000 over two years in Alliantie van Kracht’s intergenerational-poverty project to provide more tailored support to families in Groningen and Drenthe.
现有住房、福利、医疗、教育和市镇机构已参与合作，但不少生活困难的家庭仍难获得适合: Housing, welfare, healthcare, education and municipal organisations already cooperate, but many struggling families still face barriers to suitable support.
项目让专业人员和有亲身贫困经历的居民共同试验社区及家庭支持方式，并推广有效做法。: Professionals and residents with lived experience of poverty will jointly test family and community support approaches and build on effective practices.
面临代际贫困的家庭及参与项目的地方服务机构。: Families experiencing intergenerational poverty and participating local service organisations.
32万欧元是项目经费，不是每户可领取金额；公告没有新增统一福利标准或自动申请资格: EUR 320,000 is project funding, not a per-household payment. The announcement creates no uniform new benefit rate or automatic eligibility. The broader health programme’s allocation of over EUR 55 million is not this project’s award.
弗里斯兰：村庄设施发展补助首轮10月20日开放: Fryslân: village-facility development grants open their first round on 20 October
省政府为DOM村庄发展计划安排320万欧元，支持居民与市镇共同保留、整合或改善乡: The province has allocated EUR 3.2 million to the DOM village-development scheme, supporting residents and municipalities in retaining, sharing or improving rural facilities; the first round opens on 20 October.
人口老龄化和年轻人口减少使部分村庄的会面场所、学校、医疗及公共交通设施承压。: Ageing and a shrinking young population put meeting places, education, care and public transport facilities under pressure in some villages.
居民和市镇由独立协调者协助制定综合计划。2028年实施阶段另有260万欧元，已完: Residents and municipalities develop integrated plans with an independent facilitator. 需要改善乡村设施的弗里斯兰市镇及共同参与规划的居民。: Fryslân municipalities needing better rural facilities and residents participating in planning.
2028年的项目额度不是10月首轮对每名居民的现金补助。实施阶段须重新申请并审查: The 2028 project amounts are not October cash payments to individual residents. Implementation requires a fresh application and assessment of feasibility, co-financing and other criteria; the announcement confirms neither individual awards nor a first-round closing date.
德伦特：11个市镇联合申请住房建设补助，尚未获批: Drenthe: 11 municipalities jointly seek housing-construction support; award pending
11个市镇为18个项目、逾1400套住房联合申请第九轮国家Woningbouwi: Eleven municipalities jointly applied to the ninth national Woningbouwimpuls round for 18 projects with over 1,400 homes, approximately 1,000 of which qualify as affordable housing.
该国家计划要求申请规模至少200套住房，德伦特单个较小项目往往无法单独达到门槛。: The national scheme requires applications covering at least 200 homes, a threshold many smaller individual Drenthe projects cannot meet.
市镇把项目合并申请，以争取基础设施、场地准备等建设支持；预计国家在年末年初公布资: Municipalities bundled projects to seek support for infrastructure, site preparation and other enabling works; national award decisions are expected around the turn of the year.
参与市镇、住房开发项目，以及未来的首购者、家庭和老年住户。: Participating municipalities and housing projects, and prospective first-time buyers, families and older residents.
提交申请不等于获批，公告未提供最终拨款额或入住日期，也未开设居民直接领取的购房补: Submission is not an award. The announcement provides no final grant amount or occupancy date and creates no direct homebuying payment for residents.
德伦特：2027—2035住房规划草案公开征询: Drenthe: public consultation on the 2027–2035 housing programme
省住房规划草案从10月9日起公开六周，提出到2035年需要近2万套住房，并要求新: The draft provincial housing programme is open for six weeks from 9 October. It identifies a need for nearly 20,000 homes by 2035 and aims for at least two thirds of new homes to be affordable.
家庭住宅占现有房源逾80%，但有孩子等家庭型住户仅约占三分之一；小家庭和老龄人口: Family homes make up over 80% of existing stock, while family households account for only about a third. Smaller households and an ageing population increase the mismatch between homes and needs.
草案同时提出改造空置建筑、分割房屋、促进换房及安排急需住房群体，居民和相关组织可: The draft also proposes converting vacant buildings, subdividing homes, enabling moves and arranging housing for priority groups. Residents and relevant organisations may comment.
租房者、首购者、希望缩小住房的老人、市镇、住房机构和开发者。: Renters, first-time buyers, older people seeking smaller homes, municipalities, housing organisations and developers.
这是规划草案，不是2万套已获许可或已交付住房，也不直接授予个人优先资格。公告只给: This is a draft programme, not 20,000 permitted or delivered homes, and it grants no individual priority entitlement. The announcement specifies a six-week period only; the precise closing time and submission procedure require the formal notice and are not inferred.
下萨克森铁路线完成首轮方案筛选，路线尚未确定: Nedersaksenlijn rail link completes initial options screening; route undecided
连接格罗宁根、德伦特与上艾瑟尔的Nedersaksenlijn完成“筛选0”，进: The Nedersaksenlijn linking Groningen, Drenthe and Overijssel has completed initial “screen 0” and moves to further route and station studies; no route, stations or timetable have been selected.
国家和地方正在进行铁路及沿线住房、就业发展可行性研究，居民和组织已提交多种方案。: National and regional authorities are studying rail and associated housing and employment development, with options submitted by residents and organisations.
超出任务范围的支线、过于昂贵的长隧道和全线双线方案不再研究；部分双线、电气化及不: Branches outside the remit, very costly long tunnels and double track throughout are no longer being studied. 沿线居民、通勤者、市镇以及相关住房、就业和交通规划方。: Residents, commuters, municipalities and housing, employment and transport planners along the corridor.
剔除某个方案不等于取消整个铁路项目；约2040年的可行性考量不是承诺通车日期。两: Eliminating an option does not cancel the rail project. Feasibility around 2040 is not a promised opening date. The two provinces describe the same screening exercise, retaining their separate publication dates.

格罗宁根地方政府呼吁减少地震赔偿程序负担: Groningen local authorities call for simpler earthquake-redress procedures
省政府与5个市镇联名致函众议院，要求减少居民在震损赔偿和房屋加固中的程序负担，并: The province and five municipalities jointly wrote to the lower house seeking less procedural burden in earthquake compensation and strengthening, while preserving opportunities to report future or previously unidentified damage.
Nij Begun及修复安排已经推进，但居民仍面临不同机构、评估和程序叠加；地方: Nij Begun and recovery arrangements have progressed, but residents still face overlapping organisations, assessments and procedures. Local authorities are particularly concerned about conditional finality in complex cases.
地方政府要求议会综合审查新安排对居民的影响，协调为一项修复任务，并防止用工规则不: Local authorities ask parliament to assess the combined effects on residents, coordinate one recovery task and prevent staffing-rule uncertainty from delaying cases.
震损赔偿、加固或住宅安全仍未解决的格罗宁根居民。: Groningen residents with unresolved earthquake damage, strengthening or home-safety cases.
这是地方政府政策主张，不是赔偿规则已经修改，也不证明10月7日议会讨论采纳了诉求: This is a local-government policy request, not an enacted change to compensation rules or proof that the 7 October parliamentary discussion accepted it. The effect of individual settlements and claim rights require the applicable decision and law.
荷兰更新进行中：已新增25篇中英解读、240条原始或更正记录，其中包括2026年: Dutch update in progress: added 25 Chinese/English explanations and 240 original or correction records, including 214 lower-house bill submission records from January through October 2026. Later stages and explanations for most historical bills, remaining provincial announcements and other legislative sources remain unfinished.
上艾瑟尔：N337通勤者可申请11月公交试乘报销: Overijssel: N337 commuters can apply for November bus-trial reimbursement
每周至少3天驾车经N337上班的通勤者可申请161路公交试乘，限50份名额；10: Commuters driving on the N337 for work at least three days a week may apply for a Route 161 bus trial, limited to 50 passes. Applications run from 09:00 on 12 October to 17:00 on 18 October, in order of receipt.
Olst至Den Nul的N337路段因施工关闭至12月25日，省政府此前已提供: The N337 between Olst and Den Nul is closed for works until 25 December; the province previously offered a train trial.
参与者11月1—30日使用Voordeel Oost Bus订阅乘坐Zwolle: Participants use the Voordeel Oost Bus subscription on Route 161 between Zwolle and Deventer from 1–30 November, paying first and claiming reimbursement afterward, capped at EUR 105.
符合规定驾车频率、受N337施工影响的上班通勤者。: Work commuters meeting the driving-frequency condition and affected by the N337 works.
不是所有乘客上车即免费，也不是无限额报销；名额用完可提前停止。先付款后申请报销，: This is not free boarding for every passenger or unlimited reimbursement. Places may run out early. Participants pay first and claim later; confirm allocation and subscription conditions when registering.
申请于17:00截止，名额可能先用完: Applications close at 17:00, unless places run out earlier
IJssel–Vecht公交拟提前重招标，EBS继续运营至2029年7月: IJssel–Vecht bus concession to be retendered early; EBS to continue until July 2029
上艾瑟尔、海尔德兰和弗莱福兰与EBS达成框架安排，拟把公交合同终期从2035年提: Overijssel, Gelderland and Flevoland reached outline arrangements with EBS to bring the contract end forward from 2035 to July 2029, maintaining service pending a new tender.
EBS在此区域持续亏损，经营困难、成本上升和电网拥堵使原合同失衡。: Persistent EBS losses, operational difficulties, higher costs and grid congestion have undermined the original concession.
三省拟增加财政支持，但主要损失仍由EBS承担。新合同将在未来数月设计；海尔德兰拟: The provinces plan extra financial support, while EBS bears most losses. A replacement concession will be designed over the coming months; Gelderland plans its own concession while retaining cooperation under RRReis.
三省IJssel–Vecht区域公交乘客、交通部门和运营人员。: Bus passengers, transport authorities and staff in the three-province IJssel–Vecht area.
框架安排尚非最终合同，额外金额未公布；海尔德兰单独设合同仍需省议会决定。此公告不: The outline arrangements are not final contracts and extra amounts are unpublished. A separate Gelderland concession still requires provincial assembly approval. The announcement does not establish current route cancellations or an immediate fare change.
合作省份的同一公交合同公告: Partner province’s notice on the same bus concession
同样确认EBS、IJssel–Vecht及2035年提前至2029年7月的框架安: Identifies the same EBS/IJssel–Vecht outline arrangement bringing the end forward from 2035 to July 2029.
Deventer A1四台风机计划启动程序，替代方案可提交至11月17日: Deventer A1 four-turbine proposal starts its procedure; alternatives invited through 17 November
省政府启动Deventer A1风电项目的正式探索程序，拟建4台风机、年发电约8: The province has formally started exploration of the Deventer A1 wind proposal: four turbines producing about 80 GWh a year. Eligible alternatives may be submitted from 7 October through 17 November.
2025年4月15日决定启动项目程序，随后才就公众参与、合作及实际推进达成安排。: A decision to initiate the procedure was made on 15 April 2025, followed by arrangements on participation, cooperation and practical implementation.
项目位于Deventer的A1公路两侧；精确位置和尺寸待环境调查。预计2027年: The proposal lies on both sides of the A1 in Deventer. Exact locations and dimensions depend on environmental studies. Draft participation and study-scope documents are expected in 2027; a final project decision remains necessary.

项目程序及替代方案征集正式公报: Official notice of the project procedure and invitation for alternatives
核对程序、替代方案条件及提交期限；不将意向视为建设许可。: Verifies the procedure, conditions for alternatives and submission period; an intention is not treated as a construction permit.

2025年10月7日决定启动程序，之后与发起方协商公众参与及费用安排。: The decision to initiate the procedure dates to 7 October 2025, followed by discussions with the promoter on participation and costs.

Steenwijkerland项目周边居民、企业和其他利益相关方。: Residents, businesses and other affected parties around the Steenwijkerland site.
公报2026-16657是10月1日发布，新闻为10月7日，两日期不能混用。项目: Gazette 2026-16657 was published on 1 October and the news item on 7 October; these dates are distinct. Construction is not approved. 荷兰：拟把社会租金涨幅写入法律，并调整低收入住房分配门槛: Netherlands: bill would codify social-rent increases and adjust low-income allocation thresholds
10月9日提交的37037号法案拟落实2025—2035住房绩效协议；涉及涨租公: Bill 37037, introduced on 9 October, would implement the 2025–2035 housing performance agreements through rent-increase formulas, low-income allocation and energy-efficient housing thresholds. It has not passed.
目前社会住房自2026年7月起一般最高涨租4.1%；月租低于350欧元及较高收入: Since July 2026 the general social-rent increase ceiling is 4.1%, with EUR 25, 50 or 100 exceptions for rents below EUR 350 or higher-income households. Appropriate-allocation income thresholds still distinguish AOW pension status.
拟按前三年平均通胀限制住房公司整体租金收入涨幅，单套低租金住房一般上限再加0.5: The bill would link housing corporations’ aggregate rent increases to three-year average inflation and generally allow 0.5 percentage points more per low-segment home, removing local increases to the aggregate ceiling. Allocation thresholds would be EUR 29,400 for one person and EUR 39,925 for larger households at 2026 price levels, without the AOW distinction. New allocations of A+ or better homes would have an appropriate-rent threshold EUR 27.40 higher.
低租金住房现有租户、新申请住房的低收入家庭、住房公司及出租低租金住房的私人房东。: Existing low-segment tenants, low-income housing applicants, housing corporations and private landlords of low-segment homes.
2027年1月1日仅为目标；法律生效仍待通过及王室决定，个别技术修订拟在公报公布: 1 January 2027 is only a target; commencement requires passage and a royal decree, with certain technical changes proposed for the day after gazette publication. EUR 27.40 changes new-allocation thresholds, not existing contracts automatically. Amounts would be indexed, income-related and low-rent exceptions remain, and middle/free-market segments are not switched to this formula.

10月6日提交的37033号法案拟扩大空置调查、限期恢复使用和临时出租工具，尚未: Bill 37033, introduced on 6 October, proposes stronger vacancy investigation, use orders and temporary letting tools. It is not law; the 13 October meeting concerns procedure.
现行法已允许设空置条例的市镇要求报告、会谈及提出使用者。另行制定的空置税授权已于: Current law already allows municipalities with a vacancy ordinance to require reporting, consultations and nominate users. Separate vacancy-tax powers commenced on 21 March 2026, but municipalities must first adopt a tax ordinance, after which the one-year vacancy period starts; there is no automatic national levy.
拟保留至少六个月的住宅空置报告门槛；协商后可要求适宜居住的住房在至少一个月期限内: The bill retains a minimum six-month residential reporting threshold. After consultation, habitable homes could face use orders allowing at least one month; non-residential premises require at least twelve months’ vacancy and at least six months to resume use. Necessary repairs and rent conditions could be imposed, with actual six-month electricity totals accessible under statutory conditions to check residential vacancy.
长期空置住宅或其他建筑的所有者、实际有使用或出租权的人、市镇和临时租户。: Owners and lawful users or lessors of long-vacant homes and other buildings, municipalities and temporary tenants.
不是查到空置就强制出售或征收。用电资料限有合理空置怀疑、智能表实测完整且低于标准: Vacancy does not trigger forced sale or expropriation. Electricity data is restricted to homes reasonably suspected vacant with complete smart-meter measurements below standard use, and cannot be used under this power for vacancy tax. Collective temporary permits for redevelopment and rent conditions for homes for sale are proposed; existing sale-home permits retain old rent rules. Old local ordinances and the experiment would end six months after commencement, whose date remains unset.

10月9日提交的37039号法案拟加强区域就业服务合作，以统一窗口向在职者、求职: Bill 37039, introduced on 9 October, would strengthen regional employment cooperation through a shared information, advice and referral service for workers, jobseekers and employers. It has not passed.
UWV与市镇已有各自法定就业支持职责及区域合作，服务资格和执行渠道仍可能分散。: UWV and municipalities already have statutory employment-support duties and regional cooperation, while eligibility and service channels may remain fragmented.
拟由UWV和中心市镇共同设立区域窗口，由中心市镇协调合作及相关资金；双方可协议让: UWV and central municipalities would jointly establish regional counters, with central municipalities coordinating cooperation and related funds. Agreements could let UWV support municipal clients and expand reintegration tools for WW claimants in a vulnerable labour-market position.
需要换工作、找工作、技能提升的人员、雇主，以及UWV、市镇、培训机构和社会伙伴。: People seeking new jobs, work or skills, employers, UWV, municipalities, training providers and social partners.
目标生效日2027年7月1日仍取决于立法和配套规则。不是新增统一现金补助或工作保: The target of 1 July 2027 depends on passage and implementing rules. It creates no universal cash benefit or job guarantee. Counter referrals require the person’s or employer’s agreement; data sent to other providers is limited to contact needs, while health and other sensitive data require specific legal authority and implementing rules, not unrestricted sharing.
核对法案档案、原始法案附件2026D50284及说明书2026D50286；附件: Dossier, original bill attachment 2026D50284 and memorandum 2026D50286 checked; original attachments are preserved with this review evidence.
荷兰：2027年起符合条件的家属可代申请长期护理评估: Netherlands: qualifying relatives may apply for long-term care assessments from 2027
成年人已无法自行申请、又缺少法定或实际代办人时，配偶或指定范围内亲属可代向CIZ: Where an adult cannot apply personally and lacks the required legal or acting representative, a spouse or specified relative may apply to CIZ for a long-term care eligibility assessment. The Act has passed; the decree published on 7 October fixes commencement for 1 January 2027.
目前须由本人、法定代表人或获书面授权的人申请；没有授权的家属不能仅凭亲属关系代办: Currently the person, a legal representative or someone with written authority must apply. Relatives without authority cannot apply merely because they are family and may first need a court-appointed representative.
新法适用于不能自行申请、没有法院指定监护或照护代表，且无书面授权人或该人不行动的: The Act covers insured adults unable to apply, without a court-appointed guardian or mentor and without a written representative who acts. A spouse, registered partner or other life partner acts first; if absent or inactive, a parent, child, sibling, grandparent or grandchild may apply.
无法理解或办理申请的成年长期护理需求者及其家属，包括因认知能力下降而无法再签署授: Adults needing long-term care who cannot understand or handle the application, and their families, including people no longer able to sign an authorisation because of cognitive decline.
改变的是代申请途径，不是自动批准护理、强制入院或免除自付费用。CIZ仍核查持续需: This changes who may apply, not automatic care approval, compulsory admission or exemption from personal contributions. CIZ still assesses criteria such as a lasting need for round-the-clock nearby care or permanent supervision. For example, from 1 January 2027 an adult child may apply for a mother with dementia who meets these conditions and lacks an acting partner; CIZ still decides eligibility.
逐项核对当前进度及原始条文；尚未通过的法案不标为已生效。: Current procedure and original provisions checked; pending bills are not labelled in force.
立法日程及两院通过记录: Legislative calendar and passage in both chambers

长期护理家属代申请生效令公布: Family long-term care commencement decree published
荷兰：拟让酒类配送方直接承担年龄核验义务，并有限放宽小型宾果活动: Netherlands: bill would make alcohol delivery age checks directly enforceable and allow limited small-stakes games
36884号法案仍在众议院审议，拟明确酒类配送不能交给未确认年满18岁的人，并允: Bill 36884 remains before the lower house. It would explicitly bar alcohol deliveries to people not verified as at least 18, and permit non-commercial small games meeting gambling-law conditions in hospitality premises.
售酒年龄门槛已经是18岁，网上卖家已须建立并执行核龄交付流程；但酒类法对“提供”: The alcohol-sales age is already 18 and online sellers must operate an age-controlled delivery process, but the Act’s prohibition on supplying alcohol does not explicitly cover separate delivery. The hospitality gambling ban also prevents otherwise qualifying small bingo gatherings.
拟明确配送方交付时的核龄责任，由NVWA加强网售与配送执法；卖家原有流程义务仍保: Delivery age checks would become directly enforceable, with stronger NVWA powers for online sales and delivery; sellers retain their own process duties. The small-game exception requires a Dutch association existing at least three years, a purpose other than gambling and no personal gain, with prizes capped at EUR 400 per series and EUR 1,550 per gathering, among other conditions. Administrative fine ceilings would track the Criminal Code’s fifth category.
网售酒类企业、配送公司、餐饮场所及举办小型非商业游戏的协会。: Online alcohol sellers, delivery companies, hospitality venues and associations organising small non-commercial games.
尚未通过或生效；不能把提案当作今天获准在酒吧开办博彩。18岁门槛没有改变，显然已: It has not passed or commenced and does not currently authorise gambling in bars. The age threshold remains 18, with the existing exception for people unmistakably older than 18. The fine ceiling is not a fixed penalty for every offence. A royal decree would set commencement, potentially by provision.
荷兰：拟要求各市镇保有完整图书馆服务，并由国家支付学校借阅版权补偿: Netherlands: bill would require full municipal library services and state-funded school lending remuneration
36902号法案拟把促进图书馆发展的任务改为保障服务的义务，包括至少一处有实体馆: Bill 36902 would replace a duty to promote libraries with a duty to provide services, including at least one facility with physical collections and professional staff. It awaits lower-house plenary debate, provisionally listed for week 50; passage and commencement dates are not fixed.
现行法律要求地方促进图书馆服务，但没有本提案这种每个市镇至少保有一处完整设施的保: Current law requires local authorities to promote library services but lacks the proposed guarantee of at least one full facility in each municipality. The bill also creates specific remuneration rules for school-library lending.
服务整体须在居民合理可达距离内，至少一处设施承担知识信息、发展教育、阅读文学、交: Services as a whole must be within reasonable reach, with at least one facility covering information, education, reading, discussion, and arts/culture, supported by physical collections and professional staff. Local authorities publish four-year plans involving libraries; provinces ensure support organisations. The state pays fair remuneration to rights holders for school lending, rather than charging pupils per loan.
欧洲荷兰各市镇以及博奈尔、圣尤斯特歇斯和萨巴的居民、图书馆、学校、作者及其他权利: Residents, libraries, schools, authors and other rights holders in Dutch municipalities and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
按7月修改后的条文，相关条款生效后的最初三个日历年暂免满足服务保障义务；首份多年: Under the July-amended text, the service duty is waived during the first three calendar years after the relevant provision commences; a royal decree sets the first plan deadline. It does not require instant compliance on publication or introduce universal free membership. Nor does the standard require a new building in every village. Exact commencement and initial-plan dates remain unset.
荷兰：拟扩大含个人资料档案的查阅与上网范围，同时保留隐私审查: Netherlands: bill widens access to archives containing personal data with privacy safeguards
36889号法案已于9月22日获众议院一致通过，参议院10月13日安排书面意见，: Bill 36889 passed the lower house unanimously on 22 September. Senate written input is scheduled for 13 October; it is not law. It would widen sensitive-record access where a requester’s personal interest prevails and permit specified historical archives online under strict conditions.
现行档案法对大规模上网公开敏感或刑事个人资料的授权不足；公开保存与可在互联网无限: Existing archives legislation lacks sufficient authority for large-scale online disclosure of sensitive or criminal personal data; public archival access and unrestricted internet dissemination are different.
拟在个人利益超过隐私保护利益且有保障时允许查阅；特定战争、战争罪、旧极权政治行为: Access would be possible where personal interests outweigh privacy interests with safeguards. A minister could designate archives concerning war, war crimes, politics under former totalitarian regimes, genocide or crimes against humanity for online access after establishing overriding public interest, necessity and proportionality, with at least four weeks’ consultation. Archivists must limit unlawful bulk copying, indexing or mining and offer reporting and review channels.
档案研究者、寻找自身或家族历史的人、资料中涉及的在世者，以及档案馆。: Researchers, people tracing personal or family history, living people identified in records, and archive institutions.
不是所有敏感档案自动公开，也没有解除使用者的隐私法律责任。众议院修改文本还对国家: Sensitive archives would not automatically become public, and users remain subject to privacy law. The amended text also gives rules for weighing access to adoption-origin information at the National Archives, including independent requests from age 12, coordinated with the new Archives Act; this is not unconditional release of complete adoption files. Commencement is proposed for the day after final publication, whose date is unknown; 13 October is not a passage vote.
众议院通过，仍待参议院: Lower house passes bill; Senate review remains
北荷兰：2027年公交班次分批调整，部分线路11月起变更: North Holland: 2027 bus timetables change in stages, with some routes changing from November
拟按前三年平均通胀限制住房公司整体租金收入涨幅，单套低租金住房一般上限再加0.5: The bill would link housing corporations’ aggregate rent increases to three-year average inflation and generally allow 0.5 percentage points more per low-segment home, removing local increases to the aggregate ceiling. Annual household income thresholds for allocation would be EUR 29,400 for one person and EUR 39,925 for larger households at 2026 price levels, without the AOW distinction. New allocations of A+ or better homes would have an appropriate-rent threshold EUR 27.40 higher.
2027年1月1日仅为目标；法律生效仍待通过及王室决定，个别技术修订拟在公报公布: 1 January 2027 is only a target; commencement requires passage and a royal decree, with certain technical changes proposed for the day after gazette publication. EUR 27.40 changes new-allocation thresholds, not existing contracts automatically. Amounts would be indexed, income-related and low-rent exceptions remain, and middle/free-market segments are not switched to this formula. For example, at 2026 values, the appropriate monthly-rent threshold for a new allocation of an A+ home to one or two people could rise from EUR 713.02 to EUR 740.42. This is an allocation threshold, not every household’s actual rent or an automatic rent increase.
农业企业不适用；申请前紧邻六个月须持续至少有0.5个全职当量的受雇员工，企业主、: Agricultural businesses are excluded. For the six months immediately before application the business must continuously employ at least 0.5 full-time equivalent, excluding the owner, executive or director-major shareholder. At least 25% of eligible costs must be the applicant’s own non-subsidised contribution; the grant covers at most 50%, leaving the rest to be financed. The same costs cannot receive duplicate public support. R&D, ordinary maintenance and general building energy installations are excluded, subject to the specific production-process exception. Partnerships are capped at EUR 100,000 overall and EUR 24,500 per firm; previous recipients under this scheme cannot apply again.
第二轮为9月21日至10月21日，支持采用已在其他企业验证的流程改进方案。每次5: The second round runs 21 September–21 October for adopting process solutions proven at other businesses. Grants are €5,000–€24,500 per application, up to 50% of costs. This round’s budget ceiling is EUR 726,250, not a statement of funds remaining; projects must finish within 24 months of dispatch of the award decision.
第二轮9月21日至10月21日，上限726250欧元；不是实时可用余额。: Second round, 21 September–21 October: EUR 726,250 ceiling, not a live available balance.
补充正式规则中的最低雇员门槛: Add the formal minimum employee threshold
补足连续六个月0.5个全职当量条件，并核对10月21日截止、合格成本与本轮预算；: Add the six-month continuous 0.5 FTE condition and verify the 21 October deadline, eligible costs and round budget; preserve the original record.
10月1日至30日受理栖息地改善项目，最多补助合格成本75%，补助不足5000欧: Habitat-improvement applications run from 1–30 October, covering at most 75% of eligible costs; grants below EUR 5,000 are not awarded. The EUR 900,000 annual budget is split into EUR 500,000 rural and EUR 400,000 urban, not this round’s remaining funds.
自然人最多1万欧元，私法法人如基金会、协会、公司最多3万，公共机构最多5万。项目: Individuals are capped at EUR 10,000, private-law entities such as foundations, associations and companies at EUR 30,000, and public bodies at EUR 50,000. Projects must substantially benefit at least four designated species, with urban sites publicly accessible. Complete applications compete through weighted scoring, requiring at least 36 points and no zero criterion; an award is not guaranteed.
申请前必须与顾问讨论方案。Natura 2000和国家自然网络内项目不适用；一般: Discuss plans with an adviser before applying. Projects within Natura 2000 or the national nature network are excluded. General planting needs at least 90% native species; food forests and specified orchards have a separate minimum 50% rule. Start within one year of award, normally complete by end-2028 and maintain results for at least ten years. The portal header says 31 October, but its body and Article 5 of the official decision say 30 October; the formal deadline remains 30 October. For example, EUR 10,000 eligible costs yields EUR 7,500 at 75%, still subject to the applicant cap and competitive scoring, not automatic payment.
现行申请门户及日期冲突: Current application portal and conflicting date
补充资格门槛并核对正式截止日: Add eligibility thresholds and verify the formal deadline
补充最低5000欧元、至少四种物种、评分及维护要求；门户顶部与正文冲突，正式决定: Add the EUR 5,000 minimum, four-species requirement, scoring and maintenance duties; despite the conflicting portal header, the formal decision confirms 30 October.
本轮新增59篇中英解读、283条原始或更正记录，复核更新4篇既有解读；众议院提交: This update adds 59 bilingual explanations and 283 original/correction records and revises four existing explanations. It includes 214 lower-house bill submissions across January–October 2026. Recent government news and eleven provincial news listings were individually reconciled; Utrecht remains blocked by access verification. Substantive explanations and later stages for most historical bills, and full parliamentary/legal-channel history, remain incomplete and are marked partial.
向众议院提交36882号法案，拟在成年人无法自行申请且缺少适当代表时，允许符合条: Bill 36882 is submitted to the lower house, proposing applications to CIZ by qualifying relatives where an adult cannot apply and lacks an appropriate representative.
6月24日签署的法律在公报2026年第170号公布；法律规定另由王室决定生效日期: The Act signed on 24 June is published as Staatsblad 2026, 170. Commencement is left to a royal decree; publication itself does not start the family-application rules.
10月3日签署的生效令公布，确定家属代申请长期护理评估法律于2027年1月1日生: The commencement decree signed on 3 October is published, fixing 1 January 2027 for the family long-term care application Act.
众议院通过家属代申请长期护理评估法案，仍须参议院审议。: The lower house passes the family long-term care application bill; Senate consideration remains.
参议院通过家属代申请长期护理评估法案；通过表决不等于规则已经实施。: The Senate passes the family long-term care application bill; passage does not itself commence the rules.
向众议院提交36889号法案，拟扩大含个人资料档案的查阅和特定历史档案的上网范围: Bill 36889 is submitted to the lower house, proposing wider access to personal-data archives and online availability of specified historical archives with privacy safeguards.
众议院一致通过经修改的36889号法案，仍须参议院审议；此时尚未成为法律。: The lower house unanimously passes amended bill 36889. Senate consideration remains; this is not enactment.
议会档案登记36902号法案提交，拟把地方促进图书馆发展的任务改为服务保障义务，: The parliamentary dossier records submission of bill 36902, proposing a municipal library service duty and remuneration rules for school-library lending.
省议会通过大型风光项目本地持有条例，要求争取50%本地持有并说明过程及结果；条例: The provincial council adopts the local-ownership ordinance for large wind and solar projects, requiring efforts toward 50% local ownership and reporting of process and results. The ordinance commences only on the day after publication.
省政府通过Tholen—Halsteren地下150kV输电连接的项目决定；通过: The provincial executive adopts the project decision for the underground Tholen–Halsteren 150 kV connection. Adoption does not mean the infrastructure is built or users are connected.
众议院通过VABA职业教育弹性法案，仍待参议院审议。: The lower house passes the VABA vocational-flexibility bill; Senate consideration remains.
参议院通过VABA职业教育弹性法案；尚须法律公布及生效安排。: The Senate passes the VABA vocational-flexibility bill; publication and commencement arrangements remain.
公报公布6月24日签署的VABA法律，包含教学时数、选修、缩短学制及相关过渡条款: The gazette publishes the VABA Act signed on 24 June, including teaching hours, electives, shorter programmes and transition provisions. Commencement must be set separately by royal decree.
公报公布6月29日签署的配套实施决定，调整职业教育相关实施规则；公布本身不代表所: The gazette publishes the implementing decree signed on 29 June, amending vocational-education rules. Publication does not itself mean all provisions commence that day.
生效令公布：多数VABA条款定于2026年8月1日生效，列明的缩短学制及相关入学: The commencement decree is published: most VABA provisions start on 1 August 2026, while the listed shorter-programme and related admission provisions start on 1 January 2027.
这是法案提交时的历史记录；日期和待审阶段描述当时状态。已核对的后续进度、现行规则: This is the historical bill-submission record; its date and pending stage describe that point in time. See the linked explanation for reviewed later progress, current rules and practical effects; this historical stage is not the latest status.
并购申报门槛拟提高，反垄断程序拟数字化: Higher merger thresholds and digital competition procedures proposed
政府的第十二次反限制竞争法修正案已于9月24日一读后转交经济委员会，尚未成为法律: The government’s twelfth GWB amendment was referred to the Economic Affairs Committee after its first reading on 24 September. It is not law; it addresses merger thresholds, procurement collusion screening, energy supervision, fees and judicial procedures.
现行GWB第35条通常要求参与企业上一财年合计全球营业额超过5亿欧元，其中一家德: Current GWB section 35 normally triggers the turnover-based merger filing route above EUR 500m combined worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year, with one participant above EUR 50m and another above EUR 17.5m in Germany. A separate EUR 400m transaction-value route and exceptions also exist.
草案拟把通常的营业额门槛提高至7.5亿／7500万／2000万欧元；交易价值路径: The ordinary turnover thresholds would rise to EUR 750m / 75m / 20m. The EUR 400m transaction-value route would also cover likely significant future activity in Germany. Its simplified notification route applies only if a full filing is not requested within two weeks of a complete notification. Above-threshold public procurement bidder data would be screened centrally, normally retained for five years and longer where enforcement proceedings remain unresolved.
主要影响并购企业、公共采购机关和受监管能源企业；这些数字是申报条件，不是税率。草: The main affected groups are merging businesses, procurement authorities and regulated energy firms. The figures are filing conditions, not tax rates. Other provisions address media cooperation, fees, legal remedies and fuel reporting. Special energy-sector abuse supervision would extend from the end of 2027 to the end of 2032.
拟议一般生效时间为公布次日，目前没有已确定的生效日。书面并购申报拟允许至2027: General commencement is proposed for the day after publication, with no confirmed date. Written merger filings would remain possible through 2027; procurement-data duties would start on 1 September 2027, with an exemption through 31 March 2028 for authorities without procurement-management systems. Current law still applies: businesses cannot use the proposed thresholds to skip a filing. The article’s opening 21/786 link is erroneous; this explanation uses the actual 21/7865 bill and 21/8302 response.

一读后转交经济委员会: Referred to the Economic Affairs Committee after first reading

汉诺威—汉堡铁路获议会支持，并要求加强沿线保护: Parliament supports Hanover–Hamburg rail planning with additional safeguards
10月8日联邦议院以416票赞成、131票反对、无人弃权通过相关决议。此前撤出议: On 8 October the Bundestag adopted the resolution by 416 votes to 131, with no abstentions. Earlier removal from the agenda did not cancel the project. The resolution supports further planning of the preferred route and adds noise protection and existing-line improvements.
该项目已列入联邦铁路需求计划的优先需求，政府21/3150号报告介绍2025年完: The project was already a priority in the federal rail requirements plan. Government report 21/3150 described preliminary planning completed in 2025 and public participation. Some safeguards beyond statutory standards needed a separate parliamentary decision; preliminary planning was not formal planning approval.
决议支持沿A7／B3的“Pink”新线方案和策勒—汉诺威既有线升级，要求特别困难: The resolution supports the Pink new-line variant along the A7/B3 and upgrades to the existing Celle–Hanover line. It requests up to EUR 100m for additional noise protection in exceptional hardship cases, subject to budget availability, proportionality and a benefit–cost ratio of at least 1.0. A separate existing-line improvement package of about EUR 250m is requested by 2034, with federal financing that must not displace the requirements-plan project’s funding.
沿线居民、铁路乘客和货运使用者将受后续规划影响。决议包括保护贝尔根—贝尔森纪念地: Residents, passengers and freight users are affected by subsequent planning. The resolution includes protection for the Bergen-Belsen memorial and further work on tunnels and noise measures. Additional regional stations remain dependent on state service orders, funding and detailed planning. The EUR 100m and EUR 250m are not personal grants.
这是已通过的议会决议，不是铁路施工许可、建成通车或确定开通日期。绿党21/844: This is an adopted parliamentary resolution, not construction permission, completion or a guaranteed opening date. Green motion 21/8447 supported the new line with additional regional stops and implementation requests; AfD motion 21/8448 called for stopping the new-line plan and prioritising the A20. Both alternatives were rejected; the main project resolution was not. The 2034 deadline for existing-line measures is not a new-line opening date.
议会决议已通过；不等于施工许可或法定生效: Parliamentary resolution adopted; not construction permission or statutory commencement
委员会建议及决议全文：第3—14页: Committee recommendation and full resolution: pages 3–14
完整审议报道末段：10月8日通过: Final section of the full proceedings report: adoption on 8 October
主决议通过，两份替代决议被否决: Main resolution adopted; both alternatives rejected
汽车能耗标签拟修正处罚条款的法律引用: Car energy-label ordinance would correct a penalty cross-reference
经济和能源部已向联邦参议院提交条例草案，修正汽车能耗标签义务的处罚依据引用。尚未: The economic affairs ministry submitted a draft ordinance to the Bundesrat to correct the penalty reference for car energy-label obligations. Consent, final publication and commencement have not been established.
现行汽车能耗标签条例第7条引用能源消费标识法第15条第1款第1项。上位法调整条款: Current section 7 of the car energy-labelling ordinance refers to section 15(1), point 1 of the Energy Consumption Labelling Act. Renumbering in the parent statute requires a matching correction to the penalty basis for existing labelling duties.
草案把第7条中的“第1项”改成“第2项”，其他标签内容和相关行为规范没有因这份修: The draft changes the section 7 reference from point 1 to point 2. It does not add label content or new conduct requirements through this amendment. Its stated purpose is to preserve enforceability of existing administrative penalties.
主要涉及新车销售、广告等既有标签义务的承担者及执法机关。购车者不会仅因这份草案新: It primarily concerns persons already responsible for new-car sales or advertising labels and enforcement authorities. The draft itself creates no new buyer tax, payment or filing duty and sets no new vehicle emissions limit.
10月7日函件是在请求联邦参议院同意；草案正文预写“参议院已同意”不构成实际通过: The 7 October covering letter requests Bundesrat consent. Prewritten draft language saying consent has been given is not evidence that it occurred. 左党和绿党分别要求扩大自雇者孕产期收入保障。两份议案是不同方案，尚未产生新的领取: The Left and Greens separately propose broader maternity-income protection for self-employed people. 普通自雇者通常不属于雇员式产假保护的完整适用范围，但并非全部没有孕产福利：符合条: Ordinary self-employed people generally fall outside full employee-style maternity protection, but not all lack maternity benefits. Qualifying statutory health-insurance members with sickness-benefit entitlement can receive maternity benefit under SGB V section 24i. Economically dependent worker-like persons may have some MuSchG protections, with exclusions for income provisions.
左党21/8461要求建立覆盖所有自雇者、类似U2的强制共同缴费机制，补偿孕产期: Left motion 21/8461 seeks a compulsory U2-like shared contribution system covering all self-employed people, compensating maternity and medically required work-interruption income losses, ordinary fixed business costs and reasonable replacement-help costs, with provision for artists’ insurance. Green motion 21/8401 separately proposes a one-off EUR 5,000 base payment, application-based supplements and replacement help, solidarity financing, advice, parental-benefit changes and evaluation after five years.
拟覆盖独立经营者的孕产风险以及维持业务的成本；具体覆盖期限需与现行孕产保护窗口及: The proposals address maternity risks and business-continuity costs for independent workers, with periods linked to maternity-protection windows and medical certification. Existing insurance benefits remain governed by current eligibility and earnings-offset rules; consulting an insurer does not depend on these motions passing.
左党方案没有确定缴费率或统一支付金额；绿党5000欧元也是拟议基础额，不是现行可: The Left motion fixes neither a contribution rate nor a uniform payment. The Greens’ EUR 5,000 is a proposed base amount, not a currently claimable payment. Neither motion fixes commencement or old/new-case transition dates. The Green document mentions a government draft in interministerial coordination, but its official full text has not been obtained; this does not establish government adoption of either party’s design.

左党拟议150欧元能源补助和320欧元气候金，尚无领取权: Left proposes EUR 150 energy relief and EUR 320 climate payment; no entitlement yet
10月8日公布的左党议案要求政府提出能源价格、补助、交通和暴利税措施。它不是已通: The Left motion published on 8 October asks the government to introduce energy-price, payment, transport and windfall-tax measures. It is not an enacted benefit law and opens no application for either payment.
已实施的另一项政府措施是2026年10月1日至12月31日汽柴油能源税每升下调1: A separate government measure already reduces petrol and diesel energy tax by 14.04 cents per litre from 1 October to 31 December 2026, approximately 17 cents including the VAT effect. Retail prices still depend on other factors and pass-through. The government also announced an aim for a temporary fuel-price cap at the start of 2027; that announcement is not an operative cap.
议案提出向通常居住在德国的人发放一次性、须缴所得税的150欧元能源危机补助，但不: The motion proposes a one-off taxable EUR 150 energy-crisis payment for ordinary residents, excluded from means-tested benefit assessment, plus a separate EUR 320 per-person climate payment funded from carbon-pricing revenue. It also proposes fossil fuel and heating-fuel margin caps, a 50% windfall tax using 2024–2025 reference years and a 15% permitted additional-profit threshold, electricity tax at the EU minimum, gas-storage enforcement and a EUR 9 public-transport ticket.
其他要求包括对指定学生、学徒和老年群体免费公共交通，高速公路120公里限速，限制: Other requests include free public transport for specified student, apprentice and senior groups, a 120 km/h motorway limit, restrictions on flights below 500 km or with a rail alternative under six hours and on private jets, and protection against energy disconnection for qualifying vulnerable consumers unable to pay. EUR 150 is not a guaranteed net amount, and EUR 320 is not its additional after-tax component.
这是左党的整体政治及立法要求，税制细节、资格执行、申请流程和开始日期均尚未由本议: These are the Left’s overall political and legislative requests. This motion establishes no detailed tax implementation, eligibility administration, application process or start date. Existing fuel-tax relief, the government’s temporary price-cap aim and this motion’s permanent margin cap are distinct measures and cannot be presented as one operative policy. No old/new-case transition is fixed by this motion.

德国自1997年起暂停征收财产税；暂停征收不等于财产税法已被废除。现阶段不能按这: Germany has not collected wealth tax since 1997; non-collection does not mean the Wealth Tax Act has been repealed. This motion’s figures cannot be used to calculate a current liability.
左党2月6日议案要求对扣除负债后的净财产恢复征税：个人免税额100万欧元，营业资: The Left motion of 6 February seeks a tax on net assets after debts, with a EUR 1m personal allowance and an additional EUR 5m business-assets allowance. It states rates rising linearly from 1% to 5% from EUR 50m taxable assets, and 12% from EUR 1bn. Payment in shares and income-tax credit are only matters to examine. The motion does not supply complete legislation for every marginal band or individual calculation.
委员会多数反对这份具体设计，但立场并不相同：SPD称赞成探讨对极大财富加强征税；: The committee majority opposed this particular design, for differing reasons. The SPD favoured exploring stronger taxation of very large fortunes. Greens cited a separate party concept with a EUR 500m allowance, a maximum marginal rate of 4% from EUR 10bn and income-tax credit. In the opposite direction, AfD motion 21/5486 of 21 April seeks repeal of the Wealth Tax Act and prevention of a state-level reintroduction.
左党方案仍应区分委员会建议与议会最终决定。绿党概念不是已提交通过的政府法案；Af: The Left proposal’s committee recommendation must remain distinct from a final parliamentary decision. The Green concept is not an adopted government bill. The AfD motion was referred to committee on 23 April; its subsequent final outcome was not established here. None of these facts creates a new collection date, transition for existing assets or filing deadline. Failure of one design does not establish consensus for another.

10月7日公布的行政规定将2021年洪灾重建补助规则有效期延至2031年12月3: The administrative provision published on 7 October extends the 2021 flood-reconstruction aid rules through 31 December 2031, effective 8 October. Extending the rules does not extend the original application deadline.
VV Wiederaufbau RLP 2021已为2021年7月14—15日暴: VV Wiederaufbau RLP 2021 already provided the basis for aid for damage from the 14–15 July 2021 floods in seven districts including Ahrweiler and the city of Trier. 这次把行政规定的失效日期推后到2031年底，并根据政府部门调整改写主管部门名称及: This amendment postpones expiry to the end of 2031 and updates ministry names and the responsibility annex after administrative changes. It does not open a new original-application round, increase grant rates or automatically cover other floods in 2026.
及时提交申请的受灾居民和有关项目仍可继续办理。当前官方私人援助说明明确：首次申请: Affected residents and projects with timely applications can continue through administration. 2031年12月31日是该行政规定有效期终点，不是个人首次申请的新截止日，也不是: 31 December 2031 is the expiry of the administrative rules, not a new deadline for original personal applications or a common completion date for every project. Existing cases remain subject to their documents, award conditions, use restrictions and applicable amendment rules.

新旅游业投资补助行政规定10月8日生效，替代2023年“VV Gastgewer: The new tourism investment grant rules took effect on 8 October, replacing the 2023 VV Gastgewerbe. Eligible investment must be at least EUR 50,000. Support targets improvements to tourism offerings, not general reimbursement for routine renovation.
此前依据2023年12月13日VV Gastgewerbe办理。新规定明确：在新: The previous basis was VV Gastgewerbe of 13 December 2023. The new rules expressly keep applications submitted before their commencement under the old rules. Existing operators do not automatically receive a grant because new rules were published.
新建或扩建的州内旅游中小企业可按规定申请。住宿通常至少10个单元，营地至少20个: Qualifying tourism SMEs investing in a new or expanded establishment in the state may apply under the rules. Accommodation normally needs at least 10 units, campsites 20 tourist pitches and restaurants 20 indoor seats plus opening requirements; mixed businesses have separate conditions. The de minimis route can cover up to 50% of eligible investment, subject to the EUR 300,000 rolling three-year enterprise-wide de minimis ceiling. The larger-investment route allows up to 20% for small and 10% for medium enterprises, normally capped at EUR 500,000 grant.
应在承担不可撤销的工程、采购等义务之前，向ISB提交电子申请并取得基本符合条件的: Before irrevocable construction, procurement or similar commitments, applicants must submit electronically to ISB and obtain written confirmation of eligibility in principle. Projects generally must finish within 24 months of starting. A tourism concept, tax and financing evidence and other documents are required, with no automatic right to approval. Land, vehicles, routine maintenance and specified other costs are excluded.
新规到2031年底有效；这是规则期限，不是已核实的实际受理窗口。60万欧元投资分: The rules run through 2031; this is their duration, not a verified operational intake window. At exactly EUR 600,000, section 6.4.2 says “up to” while 6.4.4 says “from”, creating an overlap that needs confirmation from ISB. Hotels and similar businesses in GRW areas above EUR 600,000 face a separate exclusion. Prohibited overlapping investment grants cannot fund the same project. ISB’s tourism directory currently lists a different GRW scheme: its suspension must not be applied to this new scheme, nor does the directory establish that the new application portal is open.

石荷州能源监管机构独立性入法，禁止政府和能源企业干预: Schleswig-Holstein enacts energy-regulator independence from government and energy firms
9月30日签署、10月6日公布的法律于10月7日生效，明确州能源监管机构的职责、: The law signed on 30 September and published on 6 October took effect on 7 October. It sets state energy-regulator responsibilities, independent decision-making, terms of office and autonomous budget use. It does not directly change household tariffs or award subsidies.
州与联邦网络局已有2015年职能借用协议。新法保留该分工：州机构负责未转交联邦网: A 2015 administrative agreement already assigned specified functions to the Federal Network Agency. The new law retains that allocation: the state body handles remaining functions, state-committee membership rights and relevant oversight. It does not reclaim all federal regulatory work.
机构及成员独立依法履职，不得就监管任务接受政府、公共机构或私人能源利益方的指示。: The body and members act independently under law and must not accept regulatory instructions from government, public bodies or private energy interests. Persons working for energy firms or industry associations and members of parliament or government are excluded from membership. The head serves seven years, renewable once; other members serve five to seven years with staggered endings.
监管对象和能源消费者获得更明确的机构独立保障。经费在主管部预算内单列，由监管机构: Regulated businesses and energy consumers gain explicit institutional independence safeguards. Funding is separately identified in the ministry budget and used autonomously by the regulator. The minister still appoints members and exercises personnel supervision, without displacing statutory independent decision-making.
本法没有新的税率、补助额、消费者申请程序或统一电价。职能分工仍须按能源法和既有协: The law creates no tax rate, grant amount, consumer application procedure or uniform electricity tariff. Responsibilities still depend on energy law and the existing agreement; it provides no separate retrospective individual-case or compensation transition.
黑森10月19日起调整多项行政收费，停车场光伏审查另列收费: Hesse adjusts multiple administrative fees from 19 October, including parking-area solar reviews
已公布的第十五次收费条例修正案将于10月19日生效，涉及经济、能源、交通、建筑及: The published fifteenth fee-ordinance amendment takes effect on 19 October. It changes economic, energy, transport, building and valuation fee items, including increases, time-based charging and new items. It is not a uniform increase in every fee.
这些事项此前按2012年收费条例及截至2024年的修订收费。此次修正按具体收费编: These services were charged under the 2012 ordinance as amended through 2024. This amendment changes individual numbered items. The new schedule must not be treated as already applicable before 19 October.
新增停车场光伏义务证明审查50—100欧元、豁免申请审查100—1000欧元；涉: New items charge EUR 50–100 to review parking-area solar compliance evidence and EUR 100–1,000 for exemption applications. Permission for major tram or trolleybus operational/route changes costs EUR 350–2,200; temporary permission EUR 350–1,100. Spatial compatibility assessment changes from EUR 300–5,000 to EUR 330–5,500. Property valuation reports use value/type bands: below EUR 50,000 chargeable value, the listed undeveloped-land/specified land-value report costs EUR 1,000 and the developed-property category EUR 1,400.
办理相应许可、证明、监管或估价服务的企业、业主和申请人应按实际服务编号预算。部分: Businesses, owners and applicants using the relevant permissions, certifications, supervision or valuation services should budget by the actual fee item. Certain fire-safety expert review costs may be charged separately as expenses. The valuation “chargeable value” need not equal final market value: the text’s calculation can add back specified absolute value reductions where rights or other burdens reduce value.
这些是行政服务费用，不是房产交易税或全部停车场的新光伏义务。原文没有在本次修正中: These are administrative service fees, not property-transfer tax or a new solar duty for every car park. This amendment provides no universal promise that an application date locks in the old fee; cases spanning commencement require the applicable fee-law rule. A separate sixteenth amendment mainly changes cadastral surveying fees from 1 December and should be read separately.

黑森12月起重订地籍测量收费：分地块、界点及资料质量计费: Hesse revises cadastral surveying fees from December by parcel, boundary points and record quality
10月9日公布的第十六次收费条例修正案，明确于12月1日生效。它重订设立新地块、: The sixteenth fee amendment published on 9 October expressly takes effect on 1 December. It revises charges for new parcels, boundary determination and cadastral entry, separately from the other administrative fee amendment taking effect on 19 October.
地籍测量原已按收费条例的711、712等编号收费。这次不仅改金额，也重新区分基于: Cadastral surveying already had charges under items including 711 and 712. This amendment changes both amounts and distinctions between coordinate-based and measurement-based records, on-site surveying and whether new parcels are created.
新的A1阶梯用于有关现场分割测量，合计通常包含基本费、新定／确认界点费和入籍费，: New scale A1 covers relevant on-site parcel subdivision, normally combining a base fee, newly defined/determined boundary-point charges and cadastral entry, plus EUR 20 for each marked point. Scale A2 covers the corresponding subdivision without on-site surveying; scale B covers boundary work without new parcels. Listed ordinary subdivision routes exclude elongated road, watercourse and railway facilities exceeding 100 metres.
地块分割、边界确认和地籍业务的业主或申请人需按土地价值、测量面积、界点数量、精度: Owners or applicants seeking parcel division, boundary determination and cadastral services need to account for land value, surveyed area, point count, accuracy and record type. In the lowest A1 band alone, a surveyed-area value below EUR 2,500 means a EUR 2,035 coordinate-based or EUR 2,525 measurement-based base fee. These are base fees, not total project prices or parcel sale prices.
生效日为2026年12月1日，不能提前按新表认定已经欠费。矛盾或无法使用的地籍资: Commencement is 1 December 2026; the new table cannot be treated as already creating a debt. Contradictory or unusable cadastral records causing exceptional extra work can trigger an additional charge of up to 30% of specified items. This ordinance states no universal old-application price guarantee; the chargeable time still depends on fee law and the actual case.

石荷州简化基金会年度账目，小额管理费用可免逐项证明: Schleswig-Holstein simplifies foundation accounts and small administrative-cost evidence
10月7日生效的条例允许书面或电子提交年度账目，放宽部分管理费用明细和资产证明要: The ordinance effective on 7 October permits written or electronic annual accounts and eases some administrative-cost and asset evidence requirements. 2024年条例要求逐项列出管理及业务费用，资产证明较严格。2025年底的基金会法: The 2024 ordinance required itemised administrative and operating costs and stricter asset evidence. 管理及业务费用合计低于总支出5%，或合计低于1000欧元时，原则上应免于细分和提: Itemisation and evidence of administrative and operating costs should normally be waived when their total is below 5% of all expenditure OR below EUR 1,000. Minutes approving the accounts remain required; where the charter requires an audit report, separate asset evidence is unnecessary.
例如全年总支出2万欧元、管理费用900欧元：900既低于1000欧元，也占支出4: For example, EUR 900 administrative costs on EUR 20,000 annual expenditure are both below EUR 1,000 and 4.5% of expenditure, satisfying the simplified cost-evidence condition. Asset and purpose reporting still applies. Exactly EUR 1,000 fails the amount test but may still qualify under the below-5% test.
过渡条款把条例首次适用的账目年度从2024改为2025；这不是把2025年账目重: The transition changes the first accounting year covered from 2024 to 2025; it does not create an unrestricted new filing date for 2025 accounts. Statutory special rules for family and spend-down foundations remain. Charter and supervisory requirements still apply: simplification does not abolish auditing or capital-preservation duties.

It consolidates admissions, assessment, progression and courses. Grade 12 that year retains the earlier transition, so publication is not a uniform switch date for all pupils.
此前招生由1993年条例另行规定，2026年2月条例规定高中阶段与德法毕业考试。: Admissions previously had a separate 1993 ordinance, while the February 2026 ordinance governed upper-secondary education and the Franco-German school-leaving qualification. The 0–20 scale and 10-point satisfactory threshold already appeared in February. The new ordinance replaces both state ordinances while preserving the specified final-year cohort.
学校维持5—12年级的八年学程：5年级仅德语班，6年级起设德法两部并逐步混合授课: The school has an eight-year grades 5–12 course: German classes in grade 5, German/French sections from grade 6 with increasingly integrated teaching. Grade-5 German-section entrants need ordinary Gymnasium eligibility, normally with no more than 30 per class. Oversubscription first uses announced performance criteria, then remaining places go to siblings of current pupils. Grade-6 French-section admission prioritises the Franco-German primary school. Pupils below 10 points in the partner language for two consecutive years must leave.
升级不能只看“10分及格”：初中阶段有总平均、最多两门不达标且核心课至多一门等组: Progression is not simply a 10-point pass test. Lower-secondary rules include an overall average and no more than two below-threshold subjects, at most one core subject. Grades 10→11 use separate 8-point rules; 11→12 use 10-point rules, with specified core subjects not below 5 points and other conditions. Families must check grade, subjects and exceptions; one 8-point result alone does not establish repetition.
2026/27学年12年级继续适用2月条例第8条；该条保留2008年条例经201: Grade 12 in 2026/27 retains section 8 of the February ordinance, which preserves the 2008 rules as amended in 2010. The Franco-German final examination separately follows Annexes III–V of the 2025 bilateral agreement. This is Freiburg-school scope, not a statewide change for every secondary school. Commencement is stated as the school-year start; no first teaching day is invented as an exact legal date.
2月条例第3及8条：原有评分和毕业班过渡: February ordinance sections 3 and 8: earlier scoring and final-year transition
德法学校协定及附录原文；批准法生效不等于协定生效: Franco-German school agreement and annexes; approval-law commencement is distinct from treaty entry into force
新学校条例公布，规定从2026/27学年起适用并保留毕业班过渡: New school ordinance published with 2026/27 school-year application and final-year transition
石荷州公务员追溯调薪，2027年续增3.8%；补发安排在11月: Schleswig-Holstein raises civil-service pay retroactively, with another 3.8% in 2027 and arrears in November
10月2日公布的法律分阶段调整公务员、法官及相应退休待遇，部分追溯到2025年1: The law published on 2 October phases changes to civil-service and judicial pay and relevant pensions, partly retroactive to January 2025. Basic pay rises a further 4% for 2026 and 3.8% for 2027; trainees follow a separate fixed-amount timetable. The personnel service schedules arrears with November 2026 pay.
此前按旧薪酬表支付；新法为实际有领取权的月份逐月重算，考虑当时职级、工龄档、工时: Earlier payments used the old schedules. Recalculation covers months with actual entitlement and each month’s grade, experience step, working-time share, family circumstances and pension percentage. Arrears cannot be calculated as one fixed increase times 21 or 22 months, and this is not an automatic equal raise for every state employee.
2025年A6—A15、B1、C1/C2旧制、W2/W3基本工资增3.2%，每月: For 2025, basic pay in A6–A15, B1, legacy C1/C2 and W2/W3 rises 3.2%, at least EUR 125 per month on the full-time schedule, with small extra corrections for some steps; other specified groups receive 3.26%–4.58%. Relevant basic pay rises another 4% from January 2026 and 3.8% from January 2027. Family, post, hardship and overtime components follow their own provisions. Monthly trainee basic allowances rise EUR 60 from April 2026, another EUR 60 from March 2027, and EUR 30 from January 2028.
假设某人适用2026年4%规则，调整前月基本工资4000欧元，调整后为4160欧: Hypothetically, EUR 4,000 monthly basic pay subject to the 2026 4% increase becomes EUR 4,160: EUR 160 more gross per month, not EUR 160 extra take-home pay. Pensions depend on their assessment base and individual percentage. From 3 October, the EUR 100 minimum expense threshold for healthcare-aid applications is removed; in 2027 the annual spouse/partner income eligibility threshold rises from EUR 20,000 to EUR 22,000.
补发款有税，不能承诺固定到手额或统一退税。KoPers.Digital工资单在具: Arrears are taxable; no fixed net amount or universal refund is promised. KoPers.Digital payslips generally become digital once access, authentication and required equipment conditions are met; paper continues without access, and pensioners additionally need registration. Official guidance requires eligible unregistered active staff to register by 30 November, with registration unavailable on 2–19 October; extended absence has exceptions. Retroactive legal dates are not payment dates, and future increases are not already paid.

艺术家职业空档保障：拟为艺术家社保增加新支柱: Artists’ income gaps: proposed additional social-insurance pillar
北威州的578/24号动议希望让自雇艺术家在暂时没有收入时仍能继续创作，并由新的: North Rhine-Westphalia’s motion 578/24 seeks insurance against temporary earnings gaps while self-employed artists continue their work. Consideration is scheduled for 16 October; committee support has not created a new benefit.
现行KSVG第1条覆盖符合条件艺术家和出版工作者的养老、医疗及护理保险，不含普遍: KSVG section 1 covers pension, health and long-term-care insurance for eligible artists and publicists, not general earnings-gap protection. SGB III section 28a separately permits qualifying self-employed people to apply for unemployment insurance, subject to prior insurance or benefit history, at least 15 working hours a week and normally a three-month application deadline.
要求联邦政府在艺术家社会保险内设计新增支柱，或提出等效替代方案，使暂时收入中断者: The federal government would be asked to design an additional pillar or an equivalent alternative, protecting temporary earnings gaps without requiring artists to abandon their occupation for general labour-market availability. Benefits could draw on unemployment-insurance principles; contributions, formulas, qualifying periods and duration still need legislation.
例如两次演出合约之间没有收入的自雇音乐家，是方案考虑保护的情形；仅凭这份动议现在: A self-employed musician with no income between engagements illustrates the intended situation. This motion alone does not allow an application for a new KSK bridging payment; eligibility and financing still determine who would qualify.
原案提交于2024年11月19日，2026年10月再次列入审议。劳动、财政及文化: The original motion dates from 19 November 2024 and is on the October 2026 agenda. Labour, finance and cultural committees recommend adoption. As of 11 October there is no plenary outcome, statutory amount, commencement date or retroactive compensation rule.

儿童保护中心：拟扩大多专业服务并解决医疗融资: Child-protection centres: proposed expansion and medical funding
梅前州提出、勃兰登堡和汉堡参与的动议要求全国扩大多专业儿童保护结构，并由联邦支持: A motion initiated by Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and joined by Brandenburg and Hamburg seeks nationwide multidisciplinary child-protection services with stable federal financial support. Committees additionally propose statutory health-insurance funding for medical child-protection outpatient care. Consideration is scheduled for 16 October; no new service entitlement or appropriation follows yet.
各州已有不同的儿童保护网络和医院服务。现行SGB V第118b条授权儿科医院等为: States already have different child-protection networks and hospital services. SGB V section 118b authorizes specified paediatric hospital outpatient treatment where a child’s condition requires it; that is not automatically the comprehensive centre funding sought here.
拟建立跨医疗、心理、司法和青年福利等专业的服务网络、联邦与各州工作协调机制及可靠: The proposal seeks coordinated medical, psychological, justice and youth-welfare services, federal-state coordination and reliable funding. The family committee proposes extending section 118b for medical child-protection outpatient care in qualified hospitals. The interior committee emphasizes existing local networks, quality standards and state implementation flexibility.
遭受虐待或存在虐待疑虑的儿童及家属，可能减少在多个机构之间重复求助；医院和地方服: Children facing suspected abuse and their families could need fewer separate approaches to different agencies, while hospitals and local services could gain more stable coordination and funding. This does not establish that every district already has a centre or that insurance covers every service.
532/26原案与532/1/26委员会建议是不同阶段；均未确定新待遇金额、全国: Motion 532/26 and committee recommendations 532/1/26 are separate stages. Neither sets benefit amounts, a nationwide opening date or transition rules for existing cases. The 16 October decision and subsequent legislation and budgets require separate verification.

欧盟劳动者自由流动：北威州要求加强反欺诈执行: EU worker mobility: North Rhine-Westphalia seeks stronger anti-fraud enforcement
521/26号动议要求更有效处理虚假就业、骗取福利和滥用自由流动资格，并更新行政: Motion 521/26 seeks stronger responses to sham employment, benefit fraud and abuse of free-movement status, with updated administrative guidance and examination of inter-agency data exchange. It neither removes EU workers’ residence rights nor creates a ban on everyone receiving benefits.
FreizügG/EU第2条保护符合条件的欧盟劳动者等；因非自愿失业而保留资格的: FreizügG/EU section 2 protects qualifying EU workers and others, including specified retention of status after involuntary unemployment. False documents or facts can support a finding that the right does not exist. Section 7 already regulates individual re-entry bans, duration and remedies.
北威州要求更新行政执行规范，更有力使用既有反滥用和再入境禁令工具，并研究在数据保: North Rhine-Westphalia asks for updated administrative rules, more effective use of existing anti-abuse and re-entry tools, and examination of better information sharing among benefit, tax, police and immigration authorities within data-protection law. Genuine low-paid work must be distinguished from sham employment; anti-fraud enforcement does not automatically authorize unrestricted personal-data transfers.
影响可能集中在调查虚假劳动关系的机关、涉事雇主和个人。正常在德国工作的欧盟公民不: Potential effects centre on authorities investigating sham employment, employers and affected individuals. This pending resolution does not make ordinary EU workers lose free-movement status simply because their income is low or they receive supplementary benefits.
10月16日为计划审议日。截至10月11日，未确认新的法条、数据共享权限、生效日: 16 October is a scheduled consideration date. As of 11 October no new statutory provision, data-sharing power, commencement date or reopening rule is confirmed. Committee support and the state’s assessment of the problem do not replace individual factual findings.
