诱导未成年人自伤：拟研究填补数字媒体刑法空隙: Inducing minors to self-harm: proposed examination of criminal-law gaps online
梅前州和下萨克森州要求研究：故意通过数字媒体诱导未成年人伤害自己，是否需要更明确: Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and Lower Saxony ask whether intentionally inducing minors to harm themselves through digital media requires a clearer criminal offence. Motion 534/26 is a pending request for legislative examination, not an enacted offence or sentence.
现行伤害罪、胁迫罪等可处理符合各自构成要件的行为。但自我伤害与他人直接实施伤害不: Existing bodily-harm and coercion offences cover conduct meeting their respective elements. Self-inflicted harm differs from directly injuring another person; threats, control and attribution affect whether existing provisions apply. Online inducement cannot be described as universally lawful or universally already criminal.
要求联邦政府检查刑法保护空隙，重点包括面向不特定未成年人的数字传播和危险挑战，研: The federal government would examine protection gaps, including digital communications to unspecified minors and dangerous challenges, and consider targeted criminal liability. The text calls for precise boundaries for intent and conduct, avoiding criminalization of education, journalism, therapy and legitimate discussion.
拟保护受到网络诱导的儿童和青少年，也会影响内容发布者及刑事调查。普通家长现在不能: The intended beneficiaries are children and teenagers exposed to online inducement; publishers and criminal investigations could also be affected. The resolution is not an already available new charge: conduct must still be assessed under the law applicable at the time.
9月25日转交委员会，10月16日列入全会议程。未规定法定刑、追溯适用、平台统一: The motion was referred to committees on 25 September and listed for 16 October. It sets no statutory sentence, retroactive application, general platform deletion deadline or commencement date, and does not ban all online challenges.
食物银行运输：拟减免路费和车辆税、简化捐赠手续: Food-bank transport: proposed toll and vehicle-tax relief and simpler donations
黑森州要求扩大食物银行（Tafeln）的运输路费和车辆税豁免，并简化可食用剩余食: Hesse seeks broader toll and vehicle-tax exemptions for food banks and simpler redistribution of edible surplus food. Committees also propose improvements to EU food rules and consistent treatment of public-interest transport. Consideration is scheduled for 16 October; this does not yet authorize stopping payments.
现行联邦路费主要涉及用于货运、技术许可总质量超过3.5吨的车辆；公益救灾运输已有: Federal tolls principally cover goods vehicles above 3.5 tonnes of technically permissible maximum mass, with conditional humanitarian-relief exemptions. Vehicle-tax section 3(5a) concerns humanitarian deliveries abroad and related preparation, not a general exemption for domestic food distribution. Light vehicles already outside toll scope would not receive their first exemption from this proposal.
拟修改BFStrMG和KraftStG，为食物银行提供更明确的免路费、免车辆税依: The proposal seeks clearer food-bank exemptions in BFStrMG and KraftStG. The labour committee explicitly directs food-rule simplification to EU level because food banks remain food businesses under EU law. The transport committee seeks a systematic review of public-interest toll exemptions rather than isolated organizational privileges.
可能降低食物银行收集和配送食品的车辆成本，受益并不等于领取者获得一项固定现金补助: Food banks could face lower collection and distribution costs; recipients would not thereby acquire a fixed cash benefit. Coverage of borrowed vehicles, empty return journeys and mixed uses depends on eventual legislation and conditions.
513/26原案与513/1/26修改建议尚无本次全会结果。没有确定免税起算日、: Motion 513/26 and amendments 513/1/26 have no confirmed outcome from this sitting. There is no exemption start date, repayment right for past tolls or uniform application form. Food-safety requirements have not been abolished.
现行联邦公路路费范围及豁免: Current federal road-toll scope and exemptions
宪法保卫机构查询驾驶资格：勃兰登堡提出扩大权限: Driving-entitlement inquiries: Brandenburg proposes wider intelligence access
勃兰登堡的518/26号动议要求允许宪法保卫机构获取驾驶资格登记资料，用于依法承: Brandenburg’s motion 518/26 seeks access to driving-entitlement register data for constitutional-protection agencies’ statutory work, including threat assessment. Existing keeper inquiries do not show whether a person is licensed to drive a lorry; wider powers still require legislation.
StVG第35条允许在法定任务和必要性范围内向宪法保卫机关传送车辆、车主资料。第: StVG section 35 permits vehicle and keeper data transfers for constitutional-protection agencies’ statutory tasks where necessary. Section 52 separately lists purposes such as criminal prosecution, traffic administration and controls for driving-entitlement data, without an equivalent general intelligence authorization.
要求联邦政府提出法律，使宪法保卫机构能够取得驾驶资格信息，补充对租车、共享车辆等: The federal government would be asked to legislate access to driving-entitlement information, including for assessing situations involving rented or shared vehicles. Holding a licence category and being registered as a vehicle keeper are different facts.
涉及宪法保卫机构的调查能力及被查询人的个人资料保护。查询权限扩大不等于自动吊销驾: The proposal concerns investigative capability and the privacy of people whose records are queried. Wider access would not automatically revoke licences or make possession of a lorry licence evidence of dangerous conduct by itself.
10月16日拟审议，未确认修法通过。具体查询门槛、保存期限、监督、实施日和旧数据: Consideration is scheduled for 16 October; enactment is not confirmed. Query thresholds, retention, oversight, implementation and treatment of existing data need legislation. The resolution motion has not opened the database.
现行车辆及车主登记信息传送规则: Current vehicle and keeper data-transfer rules
轻便摩托车与轻型四轮车：萨克森要求研究45改60公里时速: Mopeds and light quadricycles: Saxony seeks review of a 45-to-60 km/h change
萨克森州594/26号动议要求联邦政府推动欧盟车辆分类和驾照规则调整，使当前AM: Saxony’s motion 594/26 asks the federal government to pursue EU vehicle-classification and licence changes allowing relevant light vehicles currently associated with AM to be approved at design speeds up to 60 km/h. Initial consideration and committee referral are requested for 16 October; the current 45 km/h standard is unchanged.
L1e-B、L2e及L6e车辆的45公里时速是车辆分类和型式批准条件，不只是道路: The 45 km/h threshold for L1e-B, L2e and L6e is a vehicle-classification and type-approval condition, not merely a road speed limit. Transitional protection allows certain former East German vehicles to reach 60 km/h; this does not automatically cover new or modified vehicles.
拟推动修改欧盟168/2013号条例及配套技术规则，将有关类别的设计时速上限扩展: The motion seeks changes to EU Regulation 168/2013 and technical rules to extend the relevant categories to design speeds up to 60 km/h, with corresponding AM licence coordination. It calls for assessment of technical safety, road safety, environmental, economic and enforcement effects, particularly for rural mobility.
若日后成法，新车型、厂家认证与驾驶资格可能受影响；现在购买普通45公里车型或解除: Eventual legislation could affect new models, manufacturer approvals and licence entitlements. Buying an ordinary 45 km/h vehicle or removing its limiter does not become lawful at 60 km/h because of this motion. Posted road speed limits remain a separate requirement.
尚无欧盟修法通过、德国实施日期或旧车升级安排。原案自身也指出，提高速度带来安全收: There is no adopted EU amendment, German implementation date or upgrade arrangement for existing vehicles. The motion itself acknowledges that a causal safety benefit from higher speed is not established; a traffic-flow argument is not a proven safety finding.
既有车辆及驾照过渡规则: Existing vehicle and licence transition rules
自动驾驶示范区：拟集中支持运营，委员会仍有分歧: Autonomous-driving model regions: proposed operating support and committee differences
下萨克森与萨尔提出544/26号动议，要求集中支持少量城乡示范区，把自动驾驶及远: Lower Saxony and Saarland propose focused support for a limited number of urban and rural model regions, moving autonomous and remotely operated public transport and logistics toward regular service. Committee positions differ and the lead transport committee has not completed deliberations. No new operating approval or grant entitlement has been created.
德国已有自动驾驶法律和测试许可框架。StVG第1i条下的试验需要联邦机动车管理局: Germany already has an autonomous-driving legal and trial-authorization framework. Trials under StVG section 1i require Federal Motor Transport Authority approval, registration, an exclusively testing purpose and continuous supervision. The model-region motion does not remove these conditions.
拟支持车队、控制中心、基础设施和有期限的运营启动费用，改善创新车辆审批、测试和商: Support would cover fleets, control centres, infrastructure and time-limited initial operating costs, alongside improved approval, testing and commercial-operation pathways and work on data and EU standards. The interior committee challenges the claim that traffic rules apply only to human drivers, seeking effective police enforcement and priority for safety over economic interests.
地方公交和物流运营者、技术供应商及乘客可能受到影响，但尚无确定入选地区、单车补助: Local public-transport and logistics operators, technology suppliers and passengers could be affected. Selected regions, per-vehicle grants and application dates are not fixed. The government’s 2028 scaling ambition is a target, not a guarantee of driverless service on any particular route.
544/1/26中部分委员会建议原案通过，内政委员会要求改动，交通委员会审议未完: In 544/1/26 some committees support the original, the interior committee proposes changes and transport deliberations are incomplete. 16 October is an agenda date, not commencement. Existing trials, future regular operations and remote driving each retain their applicable authorization requirements.
现行自动与自主驾驶测试条件: Current automated and autonomous driving trial conditions
职业安全规则简化：梅前州要求整体改革，青年体检义务仍在: Occupational-safety simplification: proposed overhaul; youth medical checks remain
梅前州343/26号动议要求联邦与各州整体检视职业安全法规，优先提出青年劳动保护: Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania’s motion 343/26 seeks a federal-state review of occupational-safety legislation, prioritising a bill on young workers’ medical checks. Consideration is scheduled for 16 October; existing protection and examination duties remain.
青年首次进入工作生活，原则上须在此前14个月内完成医生检查，并向雇主提供证明；仅: Young people entering working life normally need a medical examination within the preceding 14 months and a certificate for the employer; statutory exceptions cover specified minor or short light work without expected health risks. Resolution 582/25, adopted on 21 November 2025, requested reform but did not itself amend this duty.
拟清理重复、过时的职业安全规定，合并相近内容并推进数字行政。原案明确引用582/: The proposal seeks removal of obsolete duplication, consolidation and digital administration. It expressly incorporates resolution 582/25’s request to review occupation-specific medical checks and administrative burdens while preserving protection. Separately, the labour ministry updated its simplification programme on 15 July 2026; its measures have different stages and do not establish implementation of motion 343/26.
企业、职业安全机关及准备开始培训的未成年人可能减少重复手续。当前雇主仍须核实适用: Employers, safety authorities and young people starting training could face less duplication. Employers must still check applicable examination duties and cannot rely on a simplification proposal to remove checks or lower safety requirements.
未形成统一的新体检价格、免检范围或实施日。582/25号决议、343/26号待审: No uniform new examination price, exemption scope or implementation date is established. The adopted 582/25 resolution, pending 343/26 motion and ministry programme retain separate identities. Committee support does not mean all nine relevant statutes have been rewritten.

劳动部7月更新的减负计划: Labour ministry’s updated July simplification programme
癌症康复者被遗忘权：11月起的有限保护与更广改革提案: Cancer survivors’ right to be forgotten: limited November protection and a broader proposal
543/26号动议要求为癌症康复者建立更广泛的披露豁免和数据删除规则，涉及保险、: Motion 543/26 seeks broader disclosure exemptions and data deletion for cancer survivors across insurance and consumer credit, with committee disagreement over adoption procedures. It is separate from the enacted 15-year rule for specified payment-protection insurance, which starts on 20 November.
截至10月11日，不能主张本案已带来普遍免披露权。但5月18日公布的法律第13条: As of 11 October this motion has created no general disclosure exemption. 1964年及以后出生者，一般退休年龄67岁；有45年符合条件的保险期间者通常可6: For people born in 1964 or later, ordinary pension age is 67. Its age-67.5 illustration depends on assumptions, not a fixed individual age.
以1964年出生、走35年路径的人为例，63岁比67岁早48个月，48×0.3%: For a person born in 1964 using the 35-year route, age 63 is 48 months before 67: 48 × 0.3% = a permanent 14.4% pension reduction, not a contribution rate. The 45- and 35-year qualifying conditions are not interchangeable. Employment-stage part-time retirement additionally depends on contractual and collective arrangements.

当前护理保险只承担部分成本。二至五级住院护理自付的护理费用，按入住时间有15%、: Current care insurance covers part of costs. The 2026 monthly contribution ceiling is EUR 5,812.50, with a 3.6% base rate and an applicable 0.6-percentage-point childlessness surcharge.

Separate motion 21/5828 seeks full care-cost coverage, an interim EUR 130 monthly home-care benefit increase plus EUR 100 for case coordination, monthly contribution and compulsory-insurance thresholds of EUR 15,000 followed eventually by abolition, capital and rental income contributions with the savings allowance protected, and transition from private to social care insurance. Green motion 21/8398 seeks prevention, public-private risk equalization, progressively broader contribution bases, coverage for new civil servants and self-employed entrants with protection for existing cases, staged reimbursement of EUR 5.2 billion in pandemic spending, federal funding of roughly EUR 4.5 billion yearly in carers’ pension contributions and state funding of training costs.

可能涉及地方政府、遗产维护机构、航海安全管理和居民，但此次提案本身不新增居民义务: Potential stakeholders include local authorities, heritage custodians, navigation-safety bodies and residents. 2026年7月官方指南已扩大降温支持。本土学校独立夏季舒适项目可在降温房间安装固: The July 2026 guide already broadens cooling support. 新表覆盖在法国经营手工业活动并登记于国家企业登记册的相关企业，由手工业商会按规则: The new table covers relevant craft businesses operating in France and registered in the national business register, with chambers assigning supplementary classifications under the rules. Principal activity for mixed businesses cannot always be decided solely by revenue; industrial, commercial and service rules differ.
此次分类调整不等于企业必须改变真实业务，也不自动改变集体协议、缴费或补助资格。D: Classification changes do not require changing the real business or automatically alter collective agreements, contributions or grant eligibility. 65岁以上、孕妇及符合条件的慢性病等高风险人群属于秋季重点对象；新冠秋季年龄门槛: Autumn target groups include people aged 65+, pregnant people and eligible chronic-disease/risk groups; Covid recommendations are not confined to people aged 80+. 先核对接种凭证、年龄和报销资格；未收到流感凭证的合资格者可请医师、药师、护士或助: Check eligibility, age and the reimbursement voucher; eligible people missing a flu voucher can obtain one from an authorised clinician, pharmacist, nurse or midwife. 按10月9日Ameli当季说明纠正Service Public对流感注射100%: The 9 October Ameli seasonal guidance qualifies Service Public’s broad claim of full flu-injection coverage. 法国按季度、贷款类别及期限设置最高总利率。9月公告依据第三季度市场平均利率确定第: France sets maximum total rates by quarter, loan type and term. September’s notice uses Q3 observed averages to set Q4 ceilings; publication does not automatically reprice existing contracts.
住房贷款固定利率期限不足10年上限4.09%，10年至不足20年4.68%，20: Mortgage ceilings are 4.09% for fixed terms under 10 years, 4.68% for 10 to under 20 years, and 5.40% for at least 20 years; variable-rate loans are capped at 5.52% and bridge loans at 6.49%. Include arrangement/intermediary fees and insurance/guarantee costs required to obtain the credit.
比较报价时按正确期限和贷款类型核对TAEG。名义利率低于上限仍可能因必要保险和其: Compare offers using the correct category/term and TAEG. A nominal rate below the ceiling may still exceed it after required insurance and fees. A higher ceiling does not guarantee approval or lower repayments.
本文列住房贷款数值；消费信贷、协会及地方政府贷款类别另有标准。企业和因专业经营借: Figures here cover mortgages; consumer credit, associations and local-authority borrowing have separate categories. 最高行政法院6月17日裁定的官方解读于10月7日发布。在世配偶仅有财产利益，不一: An official explanation published on 7 October covers a 17 June Conseil d’État ruling. A surviving spouse’s financial interest alone does not necessarily permit exercising the deceased’s data rights; prior directives, succession needs and notifying controllers of death require separate assessment.
GDPR一般不直接适用于死者数据，但法国《信息与自由法》第85条另有死后指示及继: GDPR generally does not directly cover deceased persons’ data, but Article 85 of the French data-protection law separately regulates post-death directives and heirs’ rights. This does not mean anyone may use such data without restriction.
本案涉及保险公司保存和使用亡妻健康数据、丈夫向CNIL投诉并挑战其决定。按DIL: The case concerned an insurer’s retention/use of a deceased wife’s health data, her husband’s CNIL complaint and challenges to CNIL decisions. According to DILA’s account, he fell outside the statutory situations for exercising her rights and his financial interest did not make him the data subject; the annulment applications were dismissed as inadmissible.
家属先区分自己被处理的数据与亡者的数据，核对亡者是否留下指示，并说明索取资料是否: Relatives should distinguish their own data from the deceased’s, check for directives, and explain whether information is needed for succession or post-death account matters. Heirs can act within statutory limits rather than inheriting every GDPR right automatically.
不予受理并不等于法院认定保险公司的全部数据行为合法，也不等于配偶或继承人一概没有: Inadmissibility does not establish that every insurer action was lawful or that spouses/heirs have no rights. The judgment archive was blocked; this entry relies on the archived DILA case summary and CNIL background guidance, without claiming a full review of the unavailable judgment text.

补足的是法定部分停工津贴差额，不是所有工资、营业损失或自愿额外付款。法令条文和两: The top-up concerns statutory partial-activity compensation, not all wages, lost turnover or voluntary extras. 这不是住宅租金IRL。没有调租条款的专业用途租约不因指数公布自动涨租；也不能把I: These are not residential IRL indices. 申请者仍须按现行5万欧元标准计算适用的小额援助累计额，并遵守具体项目条件。即便日: Applicants must continue assessing relevant cumulative de minimis aid against the current €50,000 ceiling and each scheme’s conditions. Even a future ceiling increase would still require an actual scheme, budget and award decision.

现行第23条禁止政府成员兼任议员、全国性职业代表、公职或其他职业活动，但没有本案: Current Article 23 prohibits parliamentary office, national professional representation, public employment and professional activity, but does not contain this explicit local executive/chair incompatibility. 现行第8条规定总统任命总理，并依总理建议任免其他政府成员，没有写入本案所拟人数上: Current Article 8 governs appointment of the Prime Minister and other members on the Prime Minister’s proposal, without the proposed numeric ceiling. Actual size depends on appointments.
正文仅增加一项人数规则，没有分配具体部门、列明合并名单或计算节约金额。国务秘书、: The operative text adds only a numerical rule, without allocating portfolios, naming mergers or calculating savings. 未来组阁自由可能受到限制，但不会仅因提案提交而取消任何部门、终止职务或改变居民办: Future government formation could be constrained, but filing alone abolishes no department, ends no appointment and changes no agency through which residents obtain services.
法国组织法提案拟删除受监护及保佐成年人参选的一项限制: French organic-law proposal would remove one candidacy restriction for adults under protection
第3287号提案唯一条款是废除选举法L.O.129。该条规定受监护或保佐成年人不: Proposal 3287’s sole article repeals Electoral Code L.O.129, which disqualifies adults under tutelle/curatelle. Voting rights differ from candidacy, and the text does not simultaneously remove every local-election restriction.

受保护成年人未来可能获得更广参选资格，但不能仅凭提案标题在目前办理候选登记时忽略: Protected adults could gain broader candidacy eligibility, but the proposal’s title cannot override current restrictions when registering a candidacy. Existing voting rights should not be described as first granted by this proposal.

第3239号提案拟披露比价网站与所列商家的合同、排名权重及报酬，禁止运营商与被比: Proposal 3239 would disclose contracts, ranking weights and remuneration involving listed businesses, prohibit comparator operators’ cross-ownership/activity in the compared sector, and create a DGCCRF-audited independence label.

现行规则已经在获准驶入的城外80公里/小时道路上要求头盔；巴黎及近郊等部分地区另: Current rules already require helmets on authorised out-of-town 80 km/h roads, with separate local mandates in Paris, nearby departments and other areas. Requirements elsewhere depend on local rules; France does not currently lack all helmet obligations.
提案拟把EDPM骑行中的头盔义务写入全国法律，并明确必须系好。适用细节交由经国务: The proposal would establish a nationwide statutory EDPM helmet duty and explicitly require fastening. A Conseil d’État decree would supply details; ordinary bicycles and all pedal-assist cycles are not automatically reclassified as EDPM.
骑行者将可能需要在更多区域使用合规头盔。现行地方义务仍须遵守；提案没有允许在原来: Riders could need compliant helmets in more locations. Existing local duties remain, and the proposal neither opens prohibited roads nor removes current age, speed or insurance requirements.
尚未通过。第2条拟在法律公布六个月后生效，起算点不是10月提交日，不能推算成已确: Not adopted. Article 2 proposes commencement six months after promulgation, not six months after filing in October; no April 2027 date is established. The text does not set the penalty amount for the proposed national duty.

法国“乡村Navigo”提案拟提供每月不超过50欧元的电动车租赁: France’s “rural Navigo” proposal would offer electric-car leases capped at €50 a month
第3260号提案中的Pass Navigo rural是面向依赖汽车工作的低收入: Proposal 3260’s Pass Navigo rural is a national electric-car leasing scheme for lower-income rural/periurban residents who depend on cars for work, rather than a public-transport pass. Its proposed start is 1 July 2027, with leases of at least three years.

新提案拟覆盖符合环境标准的新车及二手电动车，月租最多50欧元，保险及选配等另计。: The new proposal covers environmentally eligible new/used electric cars at up to €50 monthly, excluding insurance and options. Income, work-mileage and inadequate-transit tests require implementation; rural/intermediate-density communes use INSEE classifications. One million vehicles is a multiyear objective, not a first-year quota or individual guarantee.
合格家庭未来可能获得更低基本租金，但总用车成本仍含保险、充电及合同费用。地方政府: Eligible households could obtain lower base rent while still paying insurance, charging and contractual costs. 法国提案拟放宽无栏杆收费补缴处罚，并建立统一支付平台: French proposal would ease free-flow toll late-payment penalties and create one payment platform
第3261号提案拟允许在付款通知寄出后15日内只补缴通行费；一个月内则适用较低定: Proposal 3261 would allow toll-only settlement within 15 days after a payment notice is sent, and a reduced indemnity within one month, alongside a national lookup/payment platform. Notice dispatch and the journey date are different starting points.
当前未自动付费者一般须在通过后72小时内缴费；逾期通知含通行费和90欧元定额补偿: Current non-automatic payment is generally due within 72 hours of passage. A late-payment notice adds a €90 indemnity, reduced to €10 when settled within 15 days of dispatch. Failure to pay or contest within two months can lead to a €375 increased fine.
提案修改刑事诉讼法529-6的交易解决机制，第一阶段取消定额补偿、第二阶段延长较: It would amend the Article 529-6 settlement process, removing the indemnity in the first window and extending the reduced-indemnity window. 偶尔使用无栏杆高速的司机可能减少忘缴的附加成本和跨平台查账负担，但仍须支付通行费: Occasional users could face lower late-payment costs and less cross-platform checking, while still owing tolls. Proposed data includes plates, passage time/section, amounts and registered-holder identity/address, limited to lookup, payment and recovery.
尚未通过，无确定生效日或旧罚单赦免。较低补偿的具体金额未在该提案重新定价；平台互: Pending, with no established commencement or amnesty for old notices. 法国提案拟主动办理成年残障者照护人的养老保险并核认过去期间: French proposal would enrol carers of disabled adults proactively and recognise qualifying past periods

照护者养老保险AVA已经存在，符合条件的照护期间可形成退休权益，CAF承担缴费。: AVA already protects retirement rights for qualifying care periods, with contributions paid by CAF. CNRACL现行规则按符合条件的职业消防员实际服务时间五分之一加算，最多五年。一: CNRACL currently awards one-fifth of qualifying professional-firefighter service, capped at five years. 例如符合其余条件的30年职业消防服务，五分之一是六年，现受五年上限限制，提案则拟: For example, 30 qualifying professional-service years yield six years under the formula, currently capped at five; the proposal would permit six. 尚未通过。拟适用于公布后第六个月首日起生效的退休金；没有规定重新计算此前已经生效: Not adopted. It would apply to pensions starting on or after the first day of the sixth month following promulgation, without reopening previously effective pensions. The unknown promulgation date prevents a definite commencement date.

当前私人部门无集体约定时照护假一般最多三个月、可续且生涯最多一年；公共部门也为三: Current private-sector leave defaults to three months, renewable to one career year; public-sector leave similarly caps at one year. 拟把被指定的personne de confiance纳入，AJPA至少为净日薪: It would include designated trusted persons, set AJPA at at least 80% of net daily pay subject to a regulatory ceiling, and link payment duration to the proposed leave. 还拟设有医疗证明及细则的照护者远程办公权、年度医保承担的身心检查及省级单一窗口。: It also proposes telework with medical evidence/implementing rules, annual insured medical/psychological checks and departmental access points. 尚未通过，无确定生效日及既有休假、津贴记录如何衔接的细则。该文本未把所有职业都变: Pending, without established commencement or transition for earlier leave/allowances. The text does not make every occupation remotely performable or specify the 80%-rule ceiling, so actual entitlement cannot be calculated from the title alone.

补充团结医保C2S已存在，可免缴或按收入及年龄缴费；一般青年按家庭或符合独立条件: C2S already offers free or contributory complementary coverage depending on circumstances, income and age. 限定符合公益及非营利等要求的协会领导机构内持续服务，排除宗教和政治性质活动。养老: It targets sustained bureau-level service in qualifying nonprofit/public-interest associations, excluding religious/political activity. 第3267号提案分两步：拟于2027年调整最高金额及收入门槛，2028年再改为自: Proposal 3267 has two stages: proposed higher maxima/resource thresholds in 2027, then automatic awards with express opt-out in 2028. ASPA是按收入补差额的老年保障，需满足年龄、居住和资源等条件并提出申请。202: ASPA is means-tested differential support subject to age, residence and other conditions plus an application. 第1条拟将单人或夫妻中仅一人领取时的年最高额设为16,044欧元（月均1,337: Article 1 sets proposed annual maxima of €16,044 for a single person or one recipient in a couple (€1,337/month), and €24,060 for two recipients (€2,005/month jointly, split equally), linking resource ceilings to these figures. Article 2 proposes automatic awards with information on eligibility, recovery and opt-out.
这不会把ASPA改成不看收入的普遍养老金。现行夫妻资源上限即使只有一人领取也按夫: This would not create a universal pension irrespective of income. 第3224号提案不只有家庭减税：至少主要承担两个孩子费用的纳税人拟增加半份税务份: Proposal 3224 combines an extra half tax share for taxpayers principally supporting at least two children with a 20% payer-funded charge on outward remittances using the specified statutory money-remittance service.
现行家庭商数通常给前两个受扶养子女各半份、第三个起各一份，并按监护情况分配；家庭: The current family quotient generally adds half a share for each of the first two dependent children and one thereafter, allocated by custody, with a cap on tax savings. 有应纳所得税的相关家庭可能减税，但不是所有家庭获得同额补助，也未取消商数减税上限: Relevant taxable families could pay less income tax, without an equal cash grant for all or repeal of quotient caps. Users of covered remittance services would face added costs; not every cross-border bank transfer can be treated as covered without classifying the service.
尚未通过。税务份额拟用于公布次年1月1日起取得的收入；汇款收费拟自公布后第三个月: Pending. 第3250号提案拟直接废除2025年财政法第48条的大企业利润特别贡献。现行税仍: Proposal 3250 would repeal the large-company exceptional contribution in Article 48 of the 2025 Finance Act. The tax remains operative, while Budget Bill 3210 Article 15 separately proposes extension at reduced rates; repeal has not occurred.
2026年8月BOFiP确认现行制度覆盖自2025年12月31日起结束的前两个财: August 2026 BOFiP covers the first two financial years ending from 31 December 2025: €1 billion turnover threshold initially, €1.5 billion in year two. 3250号只提出删除第48条；相反，预算第15条拟扩至第三个财年，门槛15亿欧元: Proposal 3250 deletes Article 48. 受影响的大企业仍须按当前义务申报缴纳，不能因其中任一提案提交就停付。中小企业普通: Affected large companies must continue current filing/payment obligations. Filing either proposal is no basis to stop paying. Ordinary SME corporate tax, other levies and refunds of past payments are not automatically resolved by this simple repeal clause.
两份提案均未通过，废除案没有具体生效或旧财年退税过渡条款；预算里的第三年续征也仍: Both proposals remain pending. The repeal has no specific commencement or past-year refund transition, and the third-year extension is also proposed. Current detailed turnover, group and smoothing rules remain relevant.
2027年预算草案第15条：另拟降率续征: 2027 Budget Bill Article 15: separate reduced-rate extension proposal
法国提案拟从2028财年起采用分段企业所得税，低档税率仍限合格小企业: French proposal would introduce marginal corporate-tax bands from 2028, reserving lower bands for qualifying small firms

现行一般税率25%；符合营业额不超过1,000万欧元、实缴资本和至少75%合格持: Current general tax is 25%; qualifying firms with turnover no more than €10 million, paid-up capital and required 75% ownership can use 15% on the first €42,500, then 25%. 拟分段为：42,500欧元以下12%；其上至25万18%；25万至100万22%: Proposed slices are below €42,500 at 12%, then to €250,000 at 18%, to €1 million at 22%, to €5 million at 25%, and above at 27%. The first three require turnover strictly below €10 million and qualifying capital; others retain 25% below €1 million.

官方价格说明区分原油、炼油、运输分销及税收；公布的毛炼油指标或运输分销成本不是企: Official pricing guidance separates crude, refining, transport/distribution and taxes. 炼油端拟参考成品油报价加每升汽油9.6欧分、柴油及燃油12.4欧分；零售税前上限: At the refining stage it proposes product quotations plus 9.6 euro cents/litre for petrol and 12.4 for diesel/fuel oil. 尚未通过，无确定实施日。正文将参考窗口写为“八个报价日”又用约一周的日期描述，计: Pending, with no fixed start. The reference window calls for eight quotation days but describes roughly a week of dates, leaving ambiguity. 现行制度已经要求提供过敏原信息，餐厅可通过直接、自由查阅的书面资料告知，并非只能: Allergen information is already required; restaurants can use directly and freely accessible written information rather than only item-by-item menu entries. 患者可能少付平台加速预约、技术服务等附加费，但普通问诊费和医保自身的报销条件不会: Patients could avoid platform extras for faster appointments or technical services, while ordinary consultation charges and reimbursement conditions would not automatically disappear. 法国提案拟加强企业负责人的职业健康随访，融资保障仍只是研究报告要求: French proposal would strengthen company-head health follow-up; financing safeguards remain a report request
第3243号提案拟把已加入企业间职业健康服务的企业负责人从可享服务改为必须获得服: Proposal 3243 would turn optional occupational-health services for heads of member companies into mandatory provision, with coordinated follow-up and continuity/delegation information for illness, accident incapacity or identified health risks.

可帮助相关负责人在健康受损时安排企业运转，但没有立即创设贷款权、保险承保权、收入: It could help affected heads organise continuity during illness, but creates no immediate right to credit, insurance, income replacement or government management. 尚未通过，无确定实施日。理由书称强制加入服务，但正文仍以“已加入服务的企业负责人: Pending, with no fixed start. The memorandum describes mandatory membership, but the operative amendment retains the member-company scope; it does not establish automatic coverage of every self-employed person or non-member company head.
现行L4621-4：已加入企业负责人的可选服务: Current L4621-4: optional services for member-company heads
法国提案拟取消公务员治疗性兼职的一年上限及再次申请间隔: French proposal would remove the one-year therapeutic part-time cap and renewal waiting period for civil servants

相关公务员可能避免因法定时限被迫中断已获准的治疗性安排，但不是无医疗证明的永久少: Eligible civil servants could avoid interruption solely because the statutory limit expires, without an unconditional permanent reduced-hours right or equivalence to ordinary part-time work. 拟只保留前两段中的医生或助产士即时告知拒绝、立即提供可实施干预者姓名的规定。没有: The replacement would retain doctors’/midwives’ immediate refusal notice and names of possible providers. Later paragraphs concerning private institutions and public-service needs, and doctors’ general continuity rules, are not repealed.
目标是减少流产服务的特殊障碍，但不能概括为所有医生将无条件被迫实施流产，或所有专: The aim is to reduce specific access barriers, without making every doctor unconditionally perform abortions or equating every profession’s general rules. 尚未通过，没有确定实施或过渡日期。提案不改变现行流产期限、医保待遇或既往拒绝行为: Pending, with no fixed start or transition. It does not change current abortion time limits, reimbursement or liability for past refusals. Survey figures in the memorandum are not adopted here as independently verified facts.
医生协会关于法定专门条款和一般规则区别的说明: Medical council explanation of specific statutory and general rules
法国提案拟把严重或致残性脂肪水肿列入ALD，尚非全面免费治疗: French proposal would list severe or disabling lipoedema as an ALD, not make all treatment free
第3258号提案要求改善脂肪水肿的认识、诊断和治疗，并在HAS提出意见后，以法令: Proposal 3258 would improve knowledge, diagnosis and care and require a decree, after HAS advice, listing severe/disabling lipoedema for ALD patient-contribution exemption. Medical eligibility criteria remain to be set.
现有ALD制度已设“清单外”个案认定，但必须符合严重性、超过六个月治疗和高成本等: Existing off-list ALD assessment requires severity, treatment exceeding six months and high cost, rather than automatic lipoedema eligibility. 拟明确严重或致残形式的清单内ALD通道，由法令在HAS意见后确定医学标准。正文没: It would create a listed-ALD route for severe/disabling forms, with medical criteria set by decree after HAS advice. It contains no new surgery reimbursement list, tariff or universal eligibility rule.
符合未来标准者可能降低相关可报销治疗的自付部分，但ALD通常按医保计价范围免法定: Those meeting future criteria could reduce contributions on covered care, but ALD exemption within reimbursement rules does not automatically cover an unlisted surgery or all excess charges. Existing individual assessment differs from the proposed listed route.
尚未通过，医学标准和实施日期未定。理由书说法令应在公布后一年内出台，但正文未写这: Pending, with no settled criteria or start. The memorandum mentions a decree within one year of promulgation, but the operative article omits that deadline; no statutory one-year countdown or automatic refund for past care is established.

法国提案拟设全科医生签约患者最低比例，并禁止付费优先就诊服务: French proposal would set a minimum treating-doctor patient share and prohibit paid priority access
第3264号提案拟通过医疗协议要求独立执业全科医生承担一定比例的家庭医生签约患者: Proposal 3264 would use the medical convention to require self-employed GPs to serve as declared treating doctor for a minimum patient share, with a stated floor of 30%, and prohibit additional paid services for faster access.
现行患者可选择家庭医生，但需医生同意并完成登记；缺少家庭医生者可求助当地协调组织: Patients currently choose a treating doctor with the doctor’s consent and registration; local coordinated services may help those without one. 尚未通过，十二个月是未达成协议时的后备机制触发期限，并非所有措施固定一年后生效。: Pending. Twelve months triggers a fallback if no convention measure exists, not universal commencement after a year. 法国提案拟收紧刑事程序瑕疵导致无效的标准，同时保留核心权利保障: French proposal would tighten criminal-procedure nullity tests while preserving essential rights safeguards
第3234号提案拟在刑事程序法802条中明确：相关程序瑕疵须剥夺一项核心保障并直: Proposal 3234 would define prejudice under Criminal Procedure Code Article 802 as deprivation of an essential safeguard directly affecting rights or freedoms, with public-order nullities treated separately.
现行802条已经要求违法形式或实质程序瑕疵损害有关当事人利益，并不是每个笔误都会: Article 802 already requires prejudice to the relevant party from prescribed-form or substantial-procedure breaches; every typo does not automatically invalidate the whole case. Article 174 already leaves the investigation chamber to determine whether annulment extends to later steps.
拟要求法官结合形式要求目的、瑕疵情境和后续影响判断“核心保障”，明确宪法或条约保: Judges would assess essential safeguards through the formality’s purpose, circumstances and consequences, including constitutional/treaty rights. 可能限制单靠无直接权利影响的程序错误请求撤销的空间，但不是废除辩护权、公共秩序无: It could narrow annulment based on errors lacking direct rights effects, without abolishing defence rights, public-order nullities or safeguards against retaining acts that defeat protected rights. Courts would decide individual cases.

第3263号提案拟让享有相关公民及政治权利的法国人自动进入实际住址所在市镇选民名: Proposal 3263 would automatically register French nationals with the relevant civil/political rights in their actual-domicile commune, through INSEE coordination with communes and administrative data. It does not confer voting rights on every resident.
现行已对完成公民登记的18岁法国人及2018年后入籍者设置自动登记；搬迁通常仍需: Automatic registration already covers French nationals turning eighteen after civic registration and people naturalised after 2018; moving normally requires registration at the new address. 拟在L11建立实际住址自动登记原则，并保留未自动登记者及依法选择其他有联系市镇者: L11 would establish actual-domicile automatic registration while retaining applications for missed cases or eligible registration in another linked commune. 可能减少遗漏或住址不匹配导致的登记障碍，但不会取消投票年龄、法国国籍及权利条件，: It could reduce omissions/address mismatches without removing voting age, nationality or rights conditions, or turning non-French EU residents’ supplementary-list rights into national-election voting rights.
尚未通过，没有确定全国切换日期或旧资料迁移方案。不要据此停止当前需要的登记或名册: Pending, without a fixed nationwide switch or old-data migration plan. It is no basis to skip current registration/checks, and does not itself repeal separate territorial, consular or other eligibility arrangements.

法国已有针对符合条件大型集团的15%全球最低税，通常涉及至少四个先前财年中两个年: France already implements a 15% minimum for qualifying large groups, generally with consolidated revenue of at least €750 million in two of the preceding four years. 提案请求法国争取高于15%的全球最低有效税率、按真实经营活动分配跨国企业税权、全: It seeks a global effective minimum above 15%, allocation by real economic activity, global beneficial-ownership/asset registers, public country reports, large-wealth taxation and progressive environmental levies, without complete new tax bases, rate schedules or thresholds.
影响方向涉及大型跨国企业、财富持有人及各国税收分配，但不会因法国议员提交决议就改: The direction concerns large multinationals, wealth holders and allocation of taxing rights, without changing current company filings upon submission. The sixth UN session is scheduled for 30 November–10 December in Nairobi; a negotiation date is not treaty commencement.
法国决议尚未通过；即使通过，仍须区分外交立场、国际谈判结果和各国后续法律措施。未: The French resolution is pending. Even adoption would leave diplomatic positions, negotiated outcomes and domestic implementation distinct. 第3219号决议提案谴责尼加拉瓜镇压和剥夺国籍等行为，要求释放被任意拘押者、安全: Resolution proposal 3219 condemns repression and nationality deprivation in Nicaragua, seeks release of arbitrarily detained people, safe return and international accountability, and urges stronger French/European political pressure. 欧盟自2019年已有相关制裁框架。2026年10月9日理事会把现有措施延至202: The EU framework dates to 2019. 法国提案请求恢复法治、权力分立及司法独立，保护记者、维权者和被迫流亡者，并支持按: The proposal seeks restored rule of law, separation of powers and judicial independence, protection for journalists/defenders/exiles and international accountability consistent with UN-expert recommendations. 对受影响者体现拟议政治支持，对企业及居民的当前制裁合规则应继续看欧盟现行名单和规: It expresses proposed political support; current sanctions compliance continues to depend on EU lists/rules. The Council’s renewal cannot be attributed legally to the pending French resolution or described as sanctions having ended.
法国提案尚未通过，无直接生效日或个人赔偿、入籍程序。理由书中的事件、统计和责任指: Pending, with no direct commencement or individual compensation/nationality procedure. Events, statistics and responsibility allegations in its background differ from final criminal judgments; this explanation covers verified operative requests and current EU measures rather than validating every background assertion.
10月9日欧盟将制裁续至2027年10月: EU 9 October renewal of sanctions until October 2027
法国提案拟为休闲金属探测设申报制度及有条件的发现物所有权: French proposal would introduce declared recreational metal detection and conditional rights to finds

现行L542-1对寻找可能涉及历史、艺术或考古的物件要求事先许可。国务委员会20: Current L542-1 requires prior authorisation for detecting objects potentially relevant to history, art or archaeology. Conseil d’État decision 446688 (2022) confirms that intentional finds using an unauthorised detector cannot on that basis be treated as chance discoveries; calling it recreation creates no automatic exemption.
拟设申报即能开始的休闲制度：成年人、近五年无指定考古违法定罪、白天活动、取得土地: The proposed declaration would permit immediate recreational activity by adults without specified archaeological convictions in the previous five years, in daylight, with landowner or relevant right-holder consent, digging no deeper than 30 cm and outside archaeological zones/protected sites. State scientific study could last up to five years; recognising scientific interest would not itself transfer ownership, while failure to declare a find would trigger presumed state ownership.
主要影响探测爱好者、土地权利人及文物管理部门。新制度违规拟处第五级违警罚款，再犯: The proposal affects detector hobbyists, land right-holders and heritage authorities. 无确定生效日；发现申报期限、区域及实施细节仍需法令。条文使用“偶然发现”，不等于: No fixed commencement date; reporting deadlines and implementation details require decrees. 2022年关于探测及偶然发现的裁决: 2022 decision on detection and chance finds

A tourism or cultural designation is not a universal exemption from alcohol-sale formalities.
拟将付费烈酒生产地参观中的品尝、符合条件的原产地或质量标志葡萄酒之家付费品尝，以: Specified paid spirits-production visits, paid tastings at qualifying collective quality/origin wine houses, and exclusively local-wine tastings in listed historic buildings would be excluded from the specified on-premises-sale definition. 符合条件的生产者、酒类文化场所、活动组织者和流动商贩可能减少许可障碍；这不是允许: Qualifying producers, alcohol-culture venues, event organisers and itinerant traders could face fewer licensing obstacles. 第3245号提案拟把配电网预留容量的额外成本纳入网络资费，并扩大工业用户资费减免: Proposal 3245 would fund additional anticipatory distribution-grid capacity through network tariffs and widen industrial tariff reductions. 配电运营商拟可为邻近未来用电需求提前扩大接网设施，多出的成本由配电网络资费承担，: Distribution operators could anticipate nearby future consumption by oversizing connections; extra costs would be covered by distribution tariffs rather than the first applicant, under CRE technical/economic conditions. 商铺初始租金目前原则上由双方自由商定，续租和调整已有规则。Tascom现行制度主: Initial commercial rent is generally freely agreed, with existing rules for renewal and revision. 尚未通过，无确定实施日期或已划定区域。租金部分只针对地方决定及省长租金令实施后新: Pending, with no fixed implementation date or designated zones. 涉及租客、私人及社会住房房东和行政机关。拟新增的夏季舒适要求不是自动装空调义务；: The proposal affects tenants, private/social landlords and authorities. 尚未通过，无固定生效日期、温度数值或普遍追溯旧租金规则。不能将提案表述为首次允许: Pending, with no fixed commencement, temperature thresholds or general retrospective rule for old rents. 第3222号提案拟重新引入此前在RIPOST法案中被剔除的烟草处罚措施。宪法委员: Proposal 3222 would reintroduce tobacco-penalty measures removed from RIPOST legislation. 影响非法烟草经营及走私案件，也涉及其他符合条文的商标侵权。不能把提案中的最高刑写: The proposal concerns illicit tobacco sales/smuggling and other trademark infringements covered by the amended provisions. 现行L1115-1允许遵守法国国际承诺的地方合作、发展和人道主义援助。行政法院已: Current L1115-1 permits local cooperation, development and humanitarian assistance consistent with France’s international commitments. 第3226号提案拟用国家补助支持沿海地区搬迁、土地整备和生态修复。2026年8月: Proposal 3226 would support coastal relocation, land assembly and ecological restoration through national grants. The national coastal strategy was approved in August 2026, but this separate proposal for a fund and new taxes is not law.

研究资金可在确认风险后、列入法定城镇名单或制定地方战略前申请；后续实施项目须服务: Study funding could precede formal municipal listing or a local strategy once exposure is established. 仍待审议。两项新税拟从法律公布次年1月1日起实施，不能先写成确定的2027年税负: Pending. 现行海岸战略、规划工具及Fonds vert: Existing coastal strategy, planning tools and Fonds vert

普通风灾主要由保单的风暴保障处理；现行特别强烈气旋达到十分钟平均风速145公里/: Ordinary wind damage mainly falls under storm insurance. 影响受异常天气损害的已投保居民、企业及地方财产。第3254号沿用参议院2026年: The measure concerns insured households, businesses and local property affected by exceptional weather. 无确定生效日，也没有明文把2026年已发生灾害追溯纳入。不能把提案当成具体城镇已: There is no fixed commencement or express retroactive coverage of earlier 2026 events. 现行CatNat通常要求财产投保及灾害认定令，干旱及土壤复湿地面运动的个人财产自: Current CatNat normally requires insured property and an official recognition order; the personal-property deductible for drought/rehydration ground movement is €1,520. 拟设基金补足无认定令、保险排除或无力承担剩余费用的情况，保险公司应承担的赔款仍须: The proposed fund would fill gaps involving absent recognition, insurance exclusions or unaffordable residual costs. 提案正文有实质矛盾：第2条拟新增L125-1-6允许资助纯外观损害修复，但同条第: The operative text conflicts: proposed L125-1-6 in Article 2 allows cosmetic-damage repair support, while Article 2 III(3) excludes such repair compensation and allows only diagnostics. 2026年现有11省预防试点扩大条件: Expanded 2026 conditions for the existing eleven-department prevention pilot
现行黏土风险施工及地质调查规则: Existing clay-risk construction and geotechnical rules
法国提案拟原则上全国禁止皆伐，仅保留严格卫生例外: France proposes a nationwide clear-cutting ban with a narrowly controlled forest-health exception

现行L435-4紧缺职业特殊渠道适用至2026年12月31日，基本要求三年连续居: Current L435-4 runs until 31 December 2026 and generally requires three continuous years of residence, twelve months of relevant work in the past 24 months and current qualifying employment. 可能影响已在必要行业或紧缺岗位受雇的外国人及雇主。另一份第3253号提案采用不限: Foreign employees and employers in essential or shortage occupations could be affected. 法国拟恢复部分长期居民及家庭成员免遭OQTF的类别保护: France proposes restoring OQTF protection for specified long-term residents and family members

2024年1月28日起L611-3的类别保护限于18岁以下外国人。行政机关仍须先: Since 28 January 2024, L611-3’s categorical protection has been confined to foreign minors under eighteen. 仍是待审议员提案，没有确定生效日期，也无明文自动撤销或重审既有OQTF。旧案仍按: This is a pending member’s proposal with no fixed commencement or express automatic cancellation/reopening of existing OQTF decisions. 法国拟以年度新建社宅比例调整SRU约束，并改为连续五年后启动缺额程序: France proposes an annual social-housing production test and a five-year trigger for SRU non-compliance proceedings
第3246号提案拟改变地方政府社宅不足的认定与追赶机制：除现有存量比例条件外，加: Proposal 3246 would change how municipal social-housing shortfalls and catch-up duties operate: it adds an insufficient prior-year social-housing production share to the existing stock conditions and repeals provisions governing three-year catch-up targets. 现行SRU对符合人口、都市圈等条件的城镇要求主要住宅存量中25%或特定地区20%: Current SRU requires eligible municipalities meeting population/agglomeration criteria to hold 25%, or in specified areas 20%, social housing in their principal-residence stock, alongside annual levies, three-year production targets and non-compliance proceedings. 社宅存量低但上一年度新建比例达标的城镇，拟可不再落入该年度不足适用条件；住房需求: A municipality with a low social-housing stock but sufficient prior-year production share could fall outside that year’s shortfall test. 仍待审议，无确定生效日期，也没有明文规定旧缺额认定、既有财政扣款或现行合同自动撤: Pending, with no fixed commencement or express automatic cancellation of earlier non-compliance findings, levies or existing contracts. 现行SRU比例、追赶目标、豁免和合同: Current SRU ratios, catch-up targets, exemptions and contracts
法国拟按家庭参考收入调整工资CSG，并重写遗产赠与税: France proposes household-income-based payroll CSG and a restructuring of inheritance and gift taxation
第3252号“加薪”提案主要通过降低部分劳动收入CSG、提高高收入档及改变财产传: Proposal 3252’s “pay rise” would mainly operate through lower CSG on some employment income, a higher top band and changes to wealth-transfer taxation. 通常工资CSG为9.2%，CRDS另为0.5%，并有相应计税基础及例外。现行遗产: Ordinary payroll CSG is 9.2%, with a separate 0.5% CRDS and applicable base rules/exceptions. 拟按前第二或第三年的家庭参考税收收入及家庭份额选取劳动收入CSG税率：第一份额参: The employment-income CSG rate would depend on household reference income from the second- or third-prior year and tax shares. Thresholds rise €2,971 per extra half-share. These select a rate, not marginal slices of salary. Unrealised gains on gratuitously transferred securities/equity would also be taxed first, using a 2.5%, 12.5%, 15.5%, 25.5% schedule, with approved payment in securities where cash is insufficient. Net-pay effects depend on household reference income and other rules even if gross salary is unchanged; monthly €125 examples are sponsor estimates.
尚无确定生效或旧赠与、继承与资本利得的专门过渡安排。正文没有把作者所称150亿欧: No fixed commencement or dedicated transition for previous gifts, inheritances and gains is provided. The sponsor’s €15 billion cost and offset estimates are not secured budget resources. Calling the reform “inheritance CSG” does not replace the operative tax-code changes and repeal of spouse relief. 法国拟设儿童政策十年规划，统一质量标准并补齐地区服务缺口: France proposes a ten-year childhood programme with common quality standards and territorial catch-up
第3229号提案拟把儿童保护、健康、教育及残障服务纳入共同国家框架，结合地方需求: Proposal 3229 would bring child protection, health, education and disability services into a common national framework, using needs mapping, workforce and investment planning to reduce disrupted care. It is pending; it neither transfers all local services to the state nor already allocates a specified sum.
现行儿童保护已由国家确定方向、各省实施儿童社会援助，并有跨部门协调及2007、2: Existing child protection combines national direction, departmental child-welfare delivery, interministerial coordination and legislation from 2007, 2016 and 2022. The scientific committee report delivered to government on 22 September 2026 is another set of reform recommendations, not proof that this member’s proposal has been adopted by government or enacted.
拟每五年制定国家战略，从2027年1月1日起实行十年规划，每年报告、两年调整，并: A five-year national strategy would underpin a ten-year programme starting on 1 January 2027, with annual reporting, two-year adjustments and independent evaluations after five years and at completion. Annual needs maps would guide provision, minimum quality/qualification/staffing standards, a national equalisation fund and territorial investment arrangements. Shared data must respect privacy and professional secrecy, and individual decisions about children could not rely solely on automated processing.
儿童和家庭拟获得更连贯的预防、健康及照护路径，必要时设协调人，并参与政策设计评估: Children and families would receive more continuous prevention, health and care pathways, with a coordinator where necessary and participation in policy design/evaluation. A child could not be referred to protection solely because health, education or disability services are unavailable. Local authorities, providers, associations and professionals would face common quality/data duties while retaining their respective responsibilities and autonomy. The text supplies neither a numerical staffing ratio nor a household cash entitlement.
2027年是提案写明的规划起点，尚非已确定实施日；数据体系在公布法律后12个月内: 2027 is the proposed programme start, not an assured implementation date. Within twelve months of promulgation, a data-system roadmap would be submitted; this does not require a completed national rollout by then. Staffing standards, fund allocation and implementing details remain to be set. Existing cases are not automatically reopened, and the tobacco-tax offset clause does not secure a funded multi-year budget.
现行国家和省级儿童保护职责: Existing national and departmental child-protection responsibilities
2026年9月提交政府的改革建议报告: Reform recommendations delivered to government in September 2026
法国拟加强广播电视气候信息要求，并由INA设立观察机构: France proposes stronger climate-information duties for broadcasters and an INA observatory
第3265号提案拟要求相关广播电视节目反映气候变化的科学认知，建立年度报道目标、: Proposal 3265 would require relevant broadcasts to reflect scientific knowledge of climate change and introduce annual coverage objectives, indicators and observation. Arcom已能依信息诚实和节目管理义务采取执法措施：最高行政法院2025年11月: Arcom already enforces duties of honest information and control of broadcasts: Conseil d’État decision 497471 of 6 November 2025 upheld a €20,000 sanction over a CNews programme concerning climate claims. Separately, government outlined a climate-information plan in May 2026 and requested HCC advice by a letter dated 15 September; that consultation is distinct from this legislative proposal.
拟明确Arcom监督节目尊重关于气候变化及其人为原因的科学认知，要求相关公共广播: Arcom would explicitly oversee respect for scientific knowledge on climate change and its human causes. Relevant public broadcasters, national radio networks and terrestrial broadcasters would have annual qualitative objectives and measurable indicators, with dedicated coverage hours addressed in broadcasting agreements. An INA observatory would assess environmental coverage objectively and recommend improvements; enforcement would remain with Arcom.
受影响的是相关广播电视机构的报道安排、科学准确性和问责机制；公众可能获得更多可检: The changes concern relevant broadcasters’ coverage, scientific accuracy and accountability, potentially giving audiences more scrutinised environmental information. The text sets no identical daily minute requirement for every channel and does not make the INA observatory a new independent sanctions authority. Existing honest-information duties continue; climate misinformation was not previously wholly beyond regulation.
尚无确定生效日期或现有播出协议的明确过渡期，具体目标和执行条件仍待制定。HCC意: There is no fixed commencement or explicit transition for existing broadcasting agreements, and detailed objectives and implementation conditions remain to be set. HCC advice is due for submission and publication within six months of notification of the letter; the evidence reviewed establishes a consultation mandate, not published conclusions or a fully implemented national plan.
现行诚实信息义务及2万欧元处罚的司法审查: Judicial review of existing honest-information duties and the €20,000 sanction
2026年9月15日咨询函及六个月期限: Consultation letter dated 15 September 2026 and six-month deadline
法国拟扩大冻结资产没收机制，涵盖外国央行及特定私人资产: France proposes confiscation of frozen foreign central-bank and specified private assets
第3255号提案拟为冻结资产转为没收建立法国国内程序，并扩展至参与严重违法行为者: Proposal 3255 would establish a French procedure to turn frozen assets into confiscated assets and extend it to serious wrongdoers, specified relatives and connected entities. It remains pending: all Russian assets have not been confiscated, and frozen funds would not automatically become available for Ukrainian reconstruction.
冻结或禁止处分资产不等于转移所有权；外国央行资产另有法律保护。欧盟已安排将俄罗斯: Freezing or prohibiting disposal does not transfer ownership, and foreign central-bank assets have legal protection. The EU already directs extraordinary revenues from immobilised Russian central-bank assets toward Ukraine and related loan repayment; this differs from confiscating principal. A separate proposal, 1706, had its amended text 2756 adopted in committee on 6 May 2026; the reviewed legislative dossier does not show enactment.
外国央行或货币机构的有关资产拟可经部长会议法令决定没收，但须主管法院命令执行，并: Relevant foreign central-bank or monetary-authority assets could be confiscated by decree in the Council of Ministers, executed only under a competent court order, with qualifying prior freezes and a serious international-law violation recognised by a UN General Assembly resolution. Official diplomatic/consular assets are excluded. For private assets, a joint finance/foreign-ministers decision would cover direct participants, their spouses and descendants, controlled entities and knowing assistants or agents, under the referenced judicial procedure. Proceeds would go to the Caisse des dépôts et consignations.
提案超出已在委员会通过的央行资产版本，新增私人和家属范围；正文对配偶、后代没有另: The proposal goes beyond the committee version focused on central-bank assets by adding private persons and relatives. Its spouse/descendant category does not separately require their personal involvement, so it cannot be described merely as recovery of a wrongdoer’s own money. Banks, asset holders, state immunity and property safeguards could be affected; individual confiscations would still require the statutory conditions and court procedure.
尚无确定生效日期，实施细节待法令；既有冻结本身不会自动变成没收。正文仅规定存托银: There is no fixed commencement and implementing details require a decree; an existing freeze would not automatically become confiscation. The operative text provides for the Caisse to receive proceeds without expressly earmarking all funds for Ukraine. Article 3 requires a report within one year of promulgation, not the annual report mentioned in the memorandum. Sponsors’ assertions of international legality do not settle questions for legislative and judicial scrutiny.
已实施的俄罗斯资产超额收益安排: Existing arrangements for extraordinary revenues from Russian assets
法国拟按周调整部分燃油税，公式参数与E10适用范围仍有缺口: France proposes weekly adjustment of selected fuel taxes, with gaps in parameters and E10 coverage
第3225号提案拟在国际税前价格上涨时降低部分燃油消费税、价格下降时回升税额，以: Proposal 3225 would reduce selected fuel excise charges as international pre-tax prices rise and raise them again as prices fall, cushioning volatility. It remains pending with no fixed per-litre saving. Its coverage list and parameter cross-references are incomplete, so automatic price cuts for all petrol cannot be promised.
法国燃油零售价格包含原油、炼化、运输分销成本以及消费税和增值税。原TICPE自2: French retail fuel prices combine crude oil, refining, transport/distribution costs, excise and VAT. Since 2022 the former TICPE has been governed by the Goods and Services Tax Code’s energy-excise framework; the proposed weekly formula is not current law. Proposal 3269 on refining margins is a different pending instrument, not an implemented fuel-tax reduction.
拟恢复海关法第265条税表，对编号11、11 bis汽油、22柴油和21家用燃料: The bill would restore Customs Code article 265’s table and apply τ = a × p + b to petrol categories 11 and 11 bis, diesel 22 and domestic heating oil 21. The coefficient a is non-positive; p is the product’s weekly average international pre-tax price. Authorities would recalculate and publish weekly, subject to a reference ceiling and proposed floor. The explicit elastic-tax list omits table category 11 ter, E10 petrol, and E85.
使用列明燃料的家庭和企业可能在价格上涨时获得部分税收缓冲，但幅度取决于系数、基准: Households and businesses using listed fuels could receive a partial tax buffer during price increases, depending on parameters, limits and retail pass-through. Tax could rise again when prices fall; this is neither a permanent nor one-way tax cut. The bill does not freeze pump prices, mandate a fixed per-litre saving or abolish VAT.
没有确定生效日期。正文把系数、基准和下限的设定方式引向第二条，但第二条只有烟草税: No fixed commencement is given. The operative formula refers parameter and floor setting to Article 2, but Article 2 contains only a tobacco-tax offset, not the annual parameter rules described in the memorandum. Coordination of the restored Customs Code table with the current tax code also needs clarification. Sponsor examples of 17% or 50% cushioning are not selected statutory parameters and cannot establish definite individual savings.
法国拟重写遗产赠与减免：50万欧元额度、直系10%上限及住宅优惠仍待审议: France proposes inheritance and gift relief with €500,000 allowances, a 10% direct-line cap and a home exemption
第3230号提案包含多项不同的遗产赠与改革：年轻后代现金赠与、受赠人终身免税额、: Proposal 3230 combines distinct reforms for cash gifts to younger descendants, a recipient-lifetime allowance, a direct-line tax cap, business transfers and the principal home of the last parent to die. It is not in force; its several €500,000 amounts cannot simply be added into a guaranteed allowance for everyone.
现行父母对子女通常每位赠与人、每位子女有10万欧元免税额，15年可重新使用；符合: Current parent-child gifts generally have a €100,000 allowance per donor and child, reusable after fifteen years, plus a conditional €31,865 family cash-gift exemption. Direct-line inheritance rates run from 5% to 45%; a 20% principal-home valuation discount requires specified co-occupation conditions. Dutreil generally exempts 75% of qualifying business value, with individual retention extended from four to six years for relevant transfers from 21 February 2026.
拟对未满50岁的子女、孙辈和曾孙辈现金赠与，每一赠与人和受赠人组合免税至50万欧: Cash gifts to children, grandchildren and great-grandchildren under fifty would be exempt up to €500,000 per donor-recipient pair. Separately, a non-renewable €500,000 lifetime personal allowance would aggregate across donors, replacing Article 779 personal allowances. Combined direct-line transfer taxes would be capped at 10% of net taxable value. The principal home of the last parent to die would receive a further exemption up to €500,000 per child for rights actually inherited, without requiring the child to live there.
企业部分拟新增符合活动、就业、家族控制和至少八年持有承诺的个体企业传承免税；另对: Business measures include a new exemption for sole-business transfers subject to activity, employment, family-control and at least eight-year retention commitments. A separate income/corporation-tax credit would equal 50% of qualifying transfer duties, capped at €100,000 per transfer, with five-year business continuity and no prior shareholding by the recipient in the preceding five years. Some partition duties and fiscal recall of earlier gifts would be removed; civil-law reserved shares and accounting for gifts would remain.
终身免税额拟从公布次年1月1日起用于新传承，并计入此前已接受的传承；第七条却规定: The lifetime allowance would apply to new transfers from 1 January after publication and count prior transfers. Yet Article 7 says properly declared prior gifts must neither be recalled in later succession taxation nor reduce allowances, leaving a conflict requiring resolution; a fresh €500,000 for every transfer is not assured. Fiscal-recall removal would apply to successions opened from 1 January after promulgation without refunding earlier tax. The home exemption would apply from the first day of the month after publication, including a specified second-death rule where parents die within twelve months. Other provisions lack a single clear commencement; all require enactment first.
现行亲属免税额、15年规则及税率: Current family allowances, fifteen-year rules and rates
现行继承税及主要住宅估值条件: Current inheritance tax and principal-home valuation conditions
现行个体企业75%免税及2026年持有期限调整: Current 75% sole-business exemption and 2026 retention change
法国拟为身份盗用受害者设90天催收暂停和统一申诉渠道: France proposes a 90-day collection pause and coordinated remedies for identity-theft victims
第3228号提案拟用可更新的报案证明启动临时保护、取证及数据更正，并提高身份盗用: Proposal 3228 would use an updatable complaint certificate to trigger provisional protection, evidence disclosure and data correction while increasing identity-theft penalties. It remains pending. The certificate would cover specified disputed acts, not establish that every debt is invalid or automatically stop enforcement of an enforceable court judgment.
现行身份盗用罪通常最高一年监禁及1.5万欧元罚款，配偶或伴侣实施时为两年及3万欧: The existing identity-theft offence ordinarily carries up to one year in prison and a €15,000 fine, rising to two years and €30,000 when committed by a spouse or partner; other impersonation offences have different penalties. Victims can already complain, notify banks and administrations, check FCC/FICP/FICOBA records and seek data removal or correction, but must address the relevant matters separately.
拟将基本刑罚提高至五年及5万欧元，加重情节可至十年及15万欧元；有组织且至少十名: The basic maximum would rise to five years and €50,000, with aggravating cases reaching ten years and €150,000. Organised cases involving at least ten victims or €100,000 would reach fifteen years and €300,000. Notifying the creditor of the certificate would pause collection of the identified disputed obligation for ninety days, subject to renewal, court and mediation extensions. Creditors would acknowledge within two working days, provide available evidence within seven days and a complete file and reasons within thirty days. Once identity theft is established in the prescribed way, inaccurate data would generally be corrected or lawfully erased within fifteen days.
拟设自愿使用的国家传递服务、全国调解员及最长两年可续期、可随时关闭的身份警示；文: An optional national transmission service, national mediator and renewable identity alert lasting up to two years would be created; the alert could be deactivated at any time. Documents would go only to recipients selected by the victim, and an alert alone could not justify refusing service. Private-liability or home insurance would include minimum assistance, with caps and emergency advances to be set by decree. Article 17’s enhanced assistance after high-risk breaches specifically concerns administrations, public bodies and public-service organisations.
一般条款拟在公布法律后第六个月首日实施，警示、调解员和保险条款为第十二个月首日；: Most provisions would start on the first day of the sixth month after promulgation; alerts, the mediator and insurance would start on the first day of the twelfth month. No calendar date is yet assured. Specified protections would cover earlier acts/entries still producing effects, while criminal provisions follow ordinary temporal rules. Complaints would not automatically erase banking entries; legally retained data would be corrected and annotated. 现行报案、银行与行政救济及刑罚: Existing complaints, banking/administrative remedies and penalties
法国拟扩展牧业土地、牧工和生态服务支持制度: France proposes broader support for pastoral land, herders and environmental services
第3240号提案拟确认牧业的公共利益地位，建立省级协调、土地规划、牧工和牧犬规则: Proposal 3240 would recognise pastoralism as serving the general interest and establish departmental coordination, land-planning, herder and working-dog rules, alongside environmental-service and investment support. It remains a member’s bill, with no fixed grant amounts, herder wages or overall launch date.
法国已有牧业土地协会和牧业团体启动援助，也有羊和山羊防捕食援助，并非从零建立支持: France already supports the creation of pastoral land associations and groups and provides predation-protection assistance for sheep and goats. Applications for the 2026 predation scheme closed on 31 July; eligible expenditure runs to 31 December, with payment claims due by 30 June 2027. A 2025 National Assembly report made 45 recommendations; the report did not itself enact a reform.
拟扩大非山区适用范围，并在法律公布后两年内调查牧地和迁牧路线；未被列入调查不应因: Eligibility outside mountain areas would expand, with a survey of pastoral land and transhumance routes within two years of promulgation. Omission from the survey would not remove protection. At least one third of departmental committee members would represent pastoral groups, technical services and herders, with meetings at least twice yearly; the master plan alone could not create or change obligations. Local plans could identify pastoral zones within agricultural or natural/forest areas, subject to existing building rules and compatibility conditions for shared routes.
牧工定义拟包括雇员和自雇者，集体协议需涉及报酬、工时、休息、住宿、装备与牧犬费用: The definition of herder would include employees and self-employed workers. Collective agreements would address pay, working time, rest, housing, equipment and dog costs, without the bill itself setting wage rates. Payments would reward landscape, biodiversity, fire-prevention and soil services, with adjustments or penalty-free termination after specified climate, health or land shocks. Other provisions concern working dogs and retirement placement, pastoral fire prevention, forest grazing, local breeds, slaughter services, jointly owned land and establishment/investment support.
工作牧犬不等于享有免责，迁牧路线共用也不等于全面禁止徒步者。SAFER涉及林地牧: Working-dog status would not confer blanket immunity, and shared-route provisions would not generally ban walkers. SAFER’s proposed pastoral-forest pre-emption would remain subordinate to specified existing rights; grazing agreements and permissions retain procedural requirements. The support fund has no specified endowment, individual rate or general transition for existing contracts. Many rules depend on decrees or later agreements. Articles 3 and 5 reuse the same L.113-2-1 numbering, leaving drafting coordination unresolved.
既有牧地协会和牧业团体启动援助: Existing start-up support for pastoral associations and groups

第3241号提案将多项措施放入一份待审议法案：限制新化石项目及融资、住房节能可偿: Proposal 3241 combines restrictions on new fossil projects and finance, repayable home-renovation advances, vehicle support, farming/catering and land-use measures. Its proposed 2027–2040 milestones are not enacted commitments. Its renovation offer is a repayable advance, not a free grant.
2017年法律已为法国油气退出设立框架；符合收入等条件的自住业主已有PAR+抵押: The 2017 law already established a framework for France’s hydrocarbon exit. Eligible lower-income owner-occupiers can already obtain a PAR+ mortgage-backed renovation loan, generally repaid on sale or succession, with the state covering the first ten years’ interest. Schools already require one vegetarian meal weekly; state catering must offer a daily vegetarian option when several menus are available. The bill would extend these requirements.
拟自2027年1月限制新化石项目和为开发新项目的企业提供金融服务；“新项目”豁免: From January 2027 the bill would restrict new fossil projects and financial services to companies developing new projects. To escape the “new” definition, a project would need both required production authorisations and a final investment decision before the law took effect. Financial institutions would submit strategies in 2028 to reduce the relevant portfolio share by 90% by 2040; environmentally unfavourable tax expenditures would end in 2030. ANAH would advance up to 100% of eligible renovation costs after other aid for principal homes meeting energy/emissions thresholds, secured by a mortgage and repaid on transfer. If no transfer occurred for thirty years, repayment would fall at death/succession, not automatically at year thirty.
拟对占地至少500平方米的集体住宅设置屋顶光伏要求，新楼2027年、旧楼2035: Collective residential buildings with footprints of at least 500 m² would face roof-solar requirements, from 2027 for new buildings and 2035 for existing ones. Vehicle grants would vary by income per tax share and Crit’Air class, reaching €10,000; separate provisions envisage €100 monthly leasing for eligible households and a social EV fleet serving one million beneficiaries by end-2030. Schools would serve two vegetarian-only meals weekly, with wider daily vegetarian options from 2028. At least 50% of national CAP-plan funds would support agroecology, including at least 25% of all funds for organic farming. Other measures address routes replaceable by four-hour trains, airport expansion, climate conditions on business aid, forestry, maritime-fuel tax relief and e-commerce warehouses.
车辆最高补助只针对收入低于每份额16300欧元的相应等级车辆，并有车重、价格及新: The maximum vehicle grant is restricted to the relevant vehicle class and income below €16,300 per tax share, with weight, price and new/used conditions; Crit’Air 1 does not mean fully electric. The operative text imposes a five-year pause for data centres of at least 20 MW failing sovereignty criteria still to be defined, despite the memorandum saying ten years. Forestry restrictions vary by protection, forest type, area and slope, rather than banning all felling. Separate 1,000/2,000/3,000 m² warehouse thresholds trigger different approvals or restrictions and cannot be combined into one ban. Existing homes, data centres under construction and financial portfolios have distinct treatment. Decrees, financing and cross-references remain unresolved; existing fossil installations would not all close immediately.
现行PAR+装修贷款及偿还规则: Existing PAR+ renovation loan and repayment rules
现行学校和国家餐饮素食菜单规则: Existing school and state-catering vegetarian-menu rules

大区原已有卫生和社会培训资助，资格取决于学员身份、培训机构及名额，不能把获录取等: Regional health and social-care training support already existed, with eligibility depending on trainee status, institution and funded places. 符合条件且不属于继续学业者的学员，先使用CPF，大区补足其余教学成本；须先获录取: Eligible trainees outside continuing education use CPF first, with the Region covering the remaining teaching cost. 合资格人群包括登记且无工作的求职者、定期或临时合同人员、每周不超过24小时或每月: Eligible categories include registered unemployed jobseekers, fixed-term or temporary workers and CDI workers with no more than 24 weekly or 104 monthly hours. Ordinary full-time CDI employees, established/probationary public servants and retirees are not automatically funded. Status and supporting evidence are generally assessed by the day before entry. Successive region-funded qualifying courses normally require a ten-month gap, with exceptions for continuing education and reorientation after an uncompleted qualification.
教学成本资助不等于生活费、专业服装和所有学校收费全免；学校另收的学杂费可能由学员: Teaching-cost support does not cover all living costs, professional clothing or institution-specific charges. 9月30日更新的现行资助页面: Current funding page updated on 30 September

官方公布的2025—2030规划列出四大方向和45项行动，包括风险预防、儿童安置: The published 2025–2030 plan sets four priorities and 45 actions covering prevention, child placements, youth independence and family support. 马提尼克已有儿童社会援助ASE、居家教育支持、寄养及面向青年成年人的CJM合同。: Martinique already has ASE child welfare, home-based educational support, foster care and CJM young-adult contracts. 拟改善风险信息处理、个人儿童计划和身心健康服务，扩展应急与专业寄养、危机暂住及精: Actions would improve risk reporting, individual child plans and physical/mental health support, alongside emergency/specialist foster care, crisis respite and psychiatric coordination. 行动20提出从16岁起准备独立并设置联系人员，衔接可延伸至25岁，这不等于CJM: Action 20 proposes preparing independence from age sixteen and a continuing contact through age twenty-five; this does not extend all CJM cash entitlements to twenty-five. 发布日是2026年9月16日，标题覆盖2025—2030，但部分页脚和时间表仍写: Publication was on 16 September 2026. The title spans 2025–2030, while some footers and schedules still say 2025–2029; these dates do not prove completion. 发布规划及全文附件，逐项实施仍须核实: Plan and full attachment published; individual delivery remains to be verified

计划开始全体会议审议，非最终表决保证: Scheduled start of plenary consideration, not a guaranteed final vote

100万欧元应急安排包括债务重整财务费用、草场补播或重播、畜舍降温适应设备。财务: The €1 million emergency package covers financial costs of debt restructuring, pasture reseeding/overseeding and equipment adapting livestock buildings to heat. 受灾或经营脆弱农场须按具体项目准备材料；需要债务重整、饲草恢复或畜舍改造的农场应: Affected or vulnerable farms should prepare evidence for the relevant programme and distinguish debt restructuring, pasture recovery and building adaptation. 公告未给出应急措施的每户最高额、全部资格门槛和三项申请表；不能据此保证获批或追溯: The notice does not provide every emergency eligibility threshold, per-farm ceiling or application form. 地方制作方有望通过与承担任务的电视机构合作获得项目机会，观众则获得更多本地作品。: Regional producers may gain opportunities through cooperation with the entrusted broadcaster, while audiences benefit from local works. The policy supports creation and distribution rather than establishing a cash entitlement open to every individual.
已核实的是大区公布的任务安排与2026年补偿决定；完整合同、逐项选片标准和支付进: The evidence establishes the announced mission and 2026 compensation decision. The complete contract, selection criteria and payment progress remain unverified here. The notice does not establish selection, production or CNC funding for a particular work.
法兰西岛公布1500万欧元青年路线图，驾照与参与式预算须按细则落实: Île-de-France announces a €15 million youth roadmap; licence aid and participatory funding await detailed implementation

参与式预算目标从2027年起支持5000项青年倡议。驾照援助拟为部分医保社会领域: Participatory funding targets 5,000 youth initiatives from 2027. 青年应按学习年级、居住或就读地区、志愿服务及培训身份核对未来具体渠道；协会、学校: Young people should check the eventual route against study year, residence/training location, volunteering and course status. 来源是9月21日路线图公告，未列所有申请起止时间、收入条件、累加规则、评选方法及: The 21 September roadmap does not provide every application window, income condition, combination rule, selection method or complete adopted instrument. 每项工具有单独资格、保险扣除、审核和资金安排，不能把最高额视为保底，也不能认定所: Each tool has separate eligibility, insurance offsets, review and financing conditions. 与附件所列普通旧税额相比，新汽油税低2欧元/百升、柴油低6欧元/百升；合资格非道: Compared with the attached normal old rates, petrol falls by €2 and diesel by €6 per hectolitre; qualifying non-road diesel falls from €10 to €5. 法律把刑事或行政程序中剥夺人身自由的场所纳入探访权限，并明确部分陪同人员；律师公: The law covers places of deprivation of liberty in criminal or administrative proceedings and specifies certain companions. Bar leaders’ powers remain limited to their jurisdiction; journalists are still excluded from accompanying visits to specified sensitive locations.
刑事诉讼法第719条和公共卫生法已有议员等探访制度。本法重写场所范围，并把律师公: Existing criminal-procedure and public-health legislation already provided inspection access. The law recasts the location scope and clarifies access for bar leaders/delegates and companions; it does not open detention facilities to the general public.
法国国民议会议员、参议员及在法国当选的欧洲议员可随时探访相应场所；可由议会助理或: National Assembly members, senators and MEPs elected in France may visit at any time and be accompanied by a parliamentary assistant or staff member. Bar leaders or specifically designated delegates may bring a pre-designated bar-council lawyer. Journalists require a professional card and cannot accompany visits to police custody, court holding areas or the relevant psychiatric institutions.
监督访问有助于查验拘禁条件，但陪同、保密与安全程序仍须遵守。机构不能把普通访客手: Oversight visits support scrutiny of detention conditions, subject to companion, confidentiality and safety arrangements. Statutory inspection powers differ from ordinary visitor procedures, and family visits do not automatically acquire the same rules.
参议院10月2日跟踪页称直接适用，但最终文本仍将陪同条件交由国务委员会命令规定。: The Senate tracker of 2 October lists direct application, while the adopted text refers companion arrangements to Conseil d’État regulations. This discrepancy is retained rather than asserting that every arrangement needs no rules. No particular completed visit is established.
法国设无争议商业欠款简化追收程序，实施命令仍待核实: France establishes simplified recovery of uncontested commercial debt; implementing rules remain unverified
法律为商人之间已经开票、金额确定且到期的债权设专门程序，由司法执行员启动、商业法: The law creates a route for invoiced debts between traders that are certain, quantified and due, initiated by a judicial enforcement officer and made enforceable after the commercial court clerk checks procedure. Timely objection ends this simplified route without barring ordinary litigation.
原有小额债权程序和诉讼追收途径继续构成背景；新法为商人间发票债权另立专门章节，并: Existing small-claim and judicial recovery routes form the baseline. The law creates a separate chapter for invoiced trader-to-trader debts and distinguishes them from the older L.125-1 simplified procedure.
支付命令须说明债务依据、金额及费用，并给出一个月支付期限；期限内异议终止本程序。: The payment demand must describe the obligation, amounts and costs and give one month to pay; objection in that period ends the route. With neither full payment nor objection, a non-contestation report can be drawn up no earlier than eight days after expiry. The clerk checks procedure before making it enforceable, and service must occur within six months or it lapses. The debtor may still oppose the enforceable report.
企业债权人应保留发票及合同证据；收到命令的企业须及时核对或提出争议，不能把沉默理: Business creditors should retain invoice and contract evidence. A recipient should verify or contest the demand promptly rather than assume silence is harmless. Procedure costs fall on the debtor; ordinary consumer debts are not brought into this trader-to-trader scheme.
参议院10月7日跟踪页仍列实施的国务委员会命令待公布；本次未核实其后发布，因此不: The Senate tracker of 7 October still listed the Conseil d’État implementing decree as pending; subsequent publication is not verified, so full operational availability is not claimed. Existing disputes, enforcement and transition cases require their actual governing rules rather than being forced into an uncontested route.
法国从2027年1月6日起保障教育保护程序中的儿童获得律师: France guarantees lawyers for children in educational-protection proceedings from 6 January 2027
法律要求教育保护司法程序中的未成年人不论辨别能力均由律师协助，并由国家通过法律援: The law requires minors in judicial educational-protection proceedings to have a lawyer regardless of discernment, fully funded by state legal aid. The core provision expressly starts on 6 January 2027.
原民法第375-1条已有儿童法官和教育保护程序；新法把律师协助扩展为不以辨别能力: Civil Code article 375-1 already governed the children’s judge and educational protection. The amendment makes counsel a safeguard independent of discernment and specifies funding; publication and commencement remain distinct.
程序一开始，儿童法官即须向律师公会负责人请求指定律师，并告知儿童、法定代表人及有: At the start of proceedings, the judge must request appointment from the bar leader and notify the child, legal representatives and relevant carer/service. The child may choose counsel, and an ad hoc administrator may separately be appointed under article 388-2.
儿童、家长、照护机构及律师需为2027年的程序准备；儿童的律师与家长自己的律师、: Children, families, care services and lawyers need to prepare for the 2027 rules. The child’s lawyer, a parent’s lawyer and an ad hoc administrator are distinct roles. Full state legal aid concerns the child’s assistance in this procedure rather than all family litigation costs.
最终文本没有在7月立即启动该义务，明确生效日为2027年1月6日。既有未结案件的: The final text does not start the obligation in July; it specifies 6 January 2027. Transition for pending cases and local lawyer capacity remain unverified, so reappointment in every older case is not presumed.
