意大利学校法令：新生班级中“外国且语言基础不足”学生拟不超过30%，校内禁止遮面: Italy school decree: no more than 30% of foreign pupils lacking Italian schooling in new first-year classes; face coverings banned in school
法令自10月1日起有效，但须在公布后60天内（2026年11月29日前）由议会转: In force since 1 October, but parliament must convert it into law within 60 days of publication (by 29 November 2026) or it lapses from the start; the parliament site lists it as Chamber bill C.3133, in committee on 14 October. The nationwide student protests of 16 October targeted this decree.
10月16日意大利多地学生罢课游行，部分城市与警方冲突，抗议对象之一是9月30日: On 16 October students struck and marched across Italy, with clashes with police in some cities; one target was the urgent school decree published on 30 September. Article 13 says that from 2027/28, in first-year classes of primary, lower and upper secondary school, pupils who are not Italian citizens and lack the specified schooling background should in principle not exceed 30% per class; from this school year, pupils joining mid-year are placed by the same limit. Article 12 bans covering the face in school activities, with fines of EUR 200–1,000, and lets foreign parents whose language barriers hamper their child’s schooling be required to take free Italian courses, with fines for unjustified non-attendance.
法令之前，法律没有统一规定每班外国学生比例；新生按年龄编入相应年级，学校通常不能: Before the decree, no statute set a share of foreign pupils per class; newly arrived pupils were normally placed in the class matching their age (the decree changes this rule). There was no national fine for covering the face in school.
第13条：计入30%的是——小学：非意大利籍，且不在意大利出生或未上满两年幼儿园: Article 13 counts towards the 30%: in primary school, non-Italian citizens who were not born in Italy or did not attend at least two years of pre-school; in lower and upper secondary, non-Italian citizens who have not successfully completed at least three school years in the Italian system. Where enrolments make the limit impossible, regional school offices, after hearing head teachers, spread pupils among nearby schools, taking account of distance from home and special needs such as caring for a severely disabled relative. Schools still above the limit get a language support fund from 2027 (EUR 3.4 million in 2027, about EUR 14.14 million a year from 2028). The teachers’ board decides which year a newly arrived foreign pupil joins, no longer by age by default. Article 12: face-covering ban (except for health or teaching reasons), A2 Italian courses for parents and fines of EUR 200–1,000, imposed by the prefect.
受影响的是在意大利上学的外国籍学生及其家庭：在比例超过30%的地区，2027/2: Affected are foreign-national pupils in Italian schools and their families: where the share exceeds 30%, new first-year pupils from 2027/28 may be assigned to another nearby school, and pupils joining this year are already placed by the limit. Hypothetical example: a primary school with a single first-year class has 25 enrolments, 10 of them non-Italian citizens without two years of pre-school (40%); the decree allows at most 7 (30%) per class, and the others may be placed by the school office in nearby schools, subject to distance and family circumstances. Foreign pupils born in Italy who attended pre-school, or who have completed three years in Italian schools, are not counted.
这是紧急法令，须在11月29日前由议会转为法律，转换过程中条文可能修改，若未转换: This is an urgent decree that parliament must convert into law by 29 November; the text may change during conversion and lapses from the start if not converted. Media readings differ on the “or” in the primary school criterion; the text governs. Some media say the Senate is examining it; this site follows the parliament listing of Chamber bill C.3133, and the Senate page could not be read. Earlier non-statutory guidance such as a 2010 ministerial circular was not reviewed. The number of affected classes rests only on media and ministerial estimates; no official statistics were found.
法令须转为法律的期限（公布后60天）: Deadline for converting the decree into law (60 days after publication)
第1款30%比例及计入条件、2027/28起；第2款就近分配；第3款2026/2: Paragraph 1: 30% limit, counting criteria, from 2027/28; 2: placement in nearby schools; 3: mid-year enrolments from 2026/27; 4: language support fund; 6: class placement decided by the teachers’ board.
第1—3款父母意大利语课程与罚款；第4—6款遮面禁令、200—1,000欧元罚款: Paragraphs 1–3: Italian courses for parents and fines; 4–6: face-covering ban, EUR 200–1,000 fines imposed by the prefect.
公布次日生效并提交议会转为法律；法令于9月30日公布（官方公报第227号）。: In force from the day after publication and presented to parliament for conversion; published on 30 September (Official Gazette no. 227).
列为C.3133，“10月14日：委员会审议中”。: Listed as C.3133, “14 October: under examination in committee”.
只计非意大利籍且缺少规定学习背景的学生：小学看出生地和幼儿园年限，中学看是否在意: Only non-Italian citizens lacking the specified schooling background count: for primary school, place of birth and pre-school years; for secondary school, whether three school years were completed in Italy.
一年级编班从2027/28学年起；插班生从2026/27学年起；遮面禁令和父母语: First-year class formation from 2027/28; mid-year enrolments from 2026/27; the face-covering ban and parents’ language courses from the decree’s entry into force on 1 October.
遮面或父母无故不参加语言课程：200至1,000欧元行政罚款，由省长决定；未成年: Covering the face, or parents skipping the language course without good reason: administrative fines of EUR 200–1,000 decided by the prefect; for minors breaching the face-covering ban, the parents are fined.

瑞士拟让受全面监护的心智障碍者获得联邦投票权，咨询至2027年1月28日: Switzerland proposes federal voting rights for people with intellectual disabilities under general guardianship; consultation until 28 January 2027
现行宪法第136条把因长期无判断能力而受全面监护、或由预先委托代理人代表的人排除: Article 136 of the Federal Constitution excludes from federal political rights people under general guardianship because of lasting incapacity, or represented by a person under a precautionary mandate. Following motion 24.4266, the Federal Council proposes amending the Constitution, the Political Rights Act and the Swiss Abroad Act so that every adult Swiss citizen may vote in National Council elections and federal ballots and sign initiatives and referendums.
上述人员没有联邦层面的投票权。: These people have no federal voting rights.
拟议后，残疾或需要支持不再是排除政治权利的理由。: Under the proposal, disability or need for support would no longer exclude anyone from political rights.
影响受全面监护的心智障碍者及其家人；数个州已取消类似限制。: Affects people with intellectual disabilities under general guardianship and their families; several cantons have already lifted similar restrictions.
修宪须经议会通过，并由人民和各州双重多数投票批准；咨询期内规则不变。: The constitutional amendment needs Parliament’s approval and a vote with a majority of people and cantons; rules are unchanged during consultation.

67个世贸成员（约占世界贸易70%）的电子商务协定为数字贸易建立共同规则，核心是: The e-commerce agreement among 67 WTO members (about 70% of world trade) sets common rules for digital trade, chiefly a ban on customs duties on electronic transmissions, plus recognition of electronic procedures and documents, consumer and data protection, and cybersecurity. A ministerial declaration of 28 March 2026 agreed to bring it into force through interim arrangements. The Federal Council opened consultation on Swiss participation.
瑞士已在部分自贸协定中采用类似规则。: Switzerland already applies similar rules in some free trade agreements.
如获批准，瑞士将与其他参与方适用共同的数字贸易规则。: If approved, Switzerland would apply common digital trade rules with the other parties.

拟议申报义务、咨询期限和计划生效日。: Proposed duty, deadline and planned entry into force.

现行制度要求申报关键人用药品的供应短缺。联邦委员会拟把申报义务扩大到由经济供应部: Shortages of vital human medicines must already be reported. Consultation runs until 28 January 2027, with entry into force planned for 1 August 2027.
只有关键人用药品须申报短缺。: Only vital human medicines are subject to shortage reporting.
拟议后，指定的关键医疗器械也须申报。: Under the proposal, designated vital medical devices would also be reportable.

内政部就16项食品条例修订开始咨询，以保持与欧盟同等的健康保护：把双酚A等有害双: The Interior Department opened consultation on amending 16 food ordinances to keep health protection equal to the EU: extending the ban on bisphenol A and other hazardous bisphenols to food-contact adhesives, rubber and similar materials; a full ban on CMR substances, PFAS and endocrine disruptors in toys in line with the EU toy safety regulation; listing all countries of origin with their shares for blended honey; and allowing novel foods to be tested on volunteers before authorisation.
双酚A禁令只覆盖塑料、油墨和涂层；玩具中部分物质受限而非全面禁止。: The bisphenol A ban covered plastics, inks and coatings; certain substances in toys were restricted rather than banned outright.
拟议后上述禁令和标示要求扩大。: Under the proposal these bans and labelling rules are extended.
影响食品包装、玩具和蜂蜜的生产商、进口商和零售商；消费者会看到更详细的蜂蜜产地标: Affects producers, importers and retailers of food packaging, toys and honey; consumers would see more detailed honey origin labels.
这是咨询草案；生效日期和过渡期未在新闻稿中说明。: This is a consultation draft; the release gives no commencement date or transition period.

联邦委员会10月14日通过《宠物入境、过境和出境条例》修订，主要是重新编排条文并: On 14 October the Federal Council adopted an amendment to the ordinance on the import, transit and export of pets, mainly restructuring the provisions and adapting them to new EU rules to keep equivalence under the bilateral agricultural agreement’s veterinary annex.
适用旧版条例。: The previous version of the ordinance applied.
带猫狗等宠物出入境的人应按修订后的规则准备证件；新闻稿没有列出对个人的具体变化。: People travelling with cats, dogs and other pets should check the amended rules; the release lists no specific changes for individuals.

联邦委员会报告认为现行自愿机制足够，规则不变。: A Federal Council report finds the current voluntary mechanism sufficient; the rules stay unchanged.
应议员提案22.3930，联邦委员会通过报告：医保公司无须把全部资本收益用于降低: In response to postulate 22.3930, the Federal Council approved a report concluding that health insurers need not use all capital income to reduce premiums. Under current rules insurers may voluntarily deduct part of their capital income from basic insurance costs, and most well-capitalised insurers do so; the Federal Council says the voluntary mechanism avoids extra premium swings and allows income to build reserves when needed.

具体人群和医保报销条件以联邦公共卫生局的建议文件为准；本站未逐条核对报销规则。: Exact groups and reimbursement conditions follow the Federal Office of Public Health recommendation documents; reimbursement rules were not checked here.

新冠和RSV建议略有调整。: Covid-19 and RSV advice slightly adjusted.

新闻稿没有给出援助金额和招标时间表；协定正文见联邦公报BBl 2026 798，: The release gives no aid amount or tender timetable; the agreement text is in BBl 2026 798 and was not read here.
伯尔尼：Nods发生小牛被咬，批准射杀单只狼至12月12日: Bern: calf killed in Nods; shooting of a single wolf authorised until 12 December

Under Article 9b of the Hunting Ordinance the canton authorised the game inspectorate to shoot the single damaging wolf in Nods, Orvin, Cortébert, Courtelary, Corgémont, Sonceboz and Plateau de Diesse, limited to the Chasseral chain and Mont Sujet.

影响当地牧民和狩猎监察处；不是普遍狩猎许可。有权的团体可上诉，但上诉不停止执行。: Concerns local herders and the game inspectorate; it is not a general hunting licence. Authorised associations may appeal, but an appeal does not suspend the order.

申请内容和已批准的其他狼群。: Request and other packs already approved.
瓦莱申请整群清除Arolla-Ferpècle狼群，待联邦环境署决定: Valais asks to remove the whole Arolla-Ferpècle wolf pack; federal decision pending
瓦莱州向联邦环境署申请整群清除Arolla-Ferpècle狼群，这是2026—: Valais asked the Federal Office for the Environment to remove the entire Arolla-Ferpècle wolf pack, its sixth request in the 2026–2027 proactive regulation. 须等联邦环境署决定是否批准。: The federal office must decide whether to approve.
涉及当地牧民和狼群保护；依据2025年2月1日生效的联邦狩猎条例实施主动调控。: Concerns local herders and wolf protection; proactive regulation is based on the federal hunting ordinance in force since 1 February 2025.
这是州的申请，不是射杀决定。: This is a cantonal request, not a shooting decision.
指数基准、调整规则和税收影响。: Index basis, adjustment rules and revenue effect.
乌里：2027税年按物价上涨0.43%调高扣除额和免税额: Uri: deductions and allowances raised for tax year 2027 in line with 0.43% inflation
为抵消冷累进，乌里财政局调高州所得税和财富税中以瑞郎金额规定的扣除额和免税额，适: To offset bracket creep, Uri’s finance department raises the franc amounts of deductions and allowances in cantonal income and wealth tax for tax year 2027. 具体调整金额在页面表格中，本站未逐项转录；负通胀不会导致下调。: The adjusted amounts are in a table on the page and were not transcribed item by item; negative inflation never lowers them.
汝拉：11月1日起政党、竞选委员会和候选人须公开捐款: Jura: parties, campaign committees and candidates must disclose donations from 1 November

州和市镇选举没有这些公开义务。: No such disclosure duties applied to cantonal and municipal ballots.
按上述规定向州政府办公厅或相关市镇申报，资料将公开。: Filings go to the State Chancellery or the municipality concerned and are published.
影响汝拉政党、竞选委员会和候选人；选民可了解主要资金来源。联邦选举和投票仍适用联: Affects Jura parties, campaign committees and candidates; voters can see main funding sources. Federal elections and votes remain under federal transparency rules.
新闻稿未列出申报门槛金额，以法律文本为准。: The release gives no reporting threshold; the law text governs.

联邦11月2日推出带芯片（面部图像和两枚指纹）的生物识别身份证，自愿申请。索洛图: The federal government introduces a chip-based biometric ID card (facial image and two fingerprints) on 2 November; applying is voluntary. 其他州的办理地点和预约方式不同。: Other cantons have different issuing offices and booking channels.
现行条件、拟议修改和咨询期限。: Current conditions, proposed changes and deadline.
伯尔尼拟放宽自住房产转让税豁免，咨询至2027年1月7日: Bern proposes easing the owner-occupier exemption from property transfer tax; consultation until 7 January 2027

须在规定期限内入住并连续两年完全自住。: Buyers had to move in within the deadline and live there exclusively for two years.
拟议后条件放宽如上。: Under the proposal the conditions are eased as described.
影响在伯尔尼购买自住房的人。第二套房、度假房和商业房产仍须缴税。: Affects people buying a home to live in in Bern. Second homes, holiday homes and commercial property remain taxable.
这是咨询草案，须经州议会通过；生效日期未定。: This is a consultation draft requiring the cantonal parliament’s approval; no commencement date is set.
法案目的和时间要求。: Purpose and timing of the bill.

影响在日内瓦的乌克兰等受保护者；目的不是增减援助，而是避免身份转换造成差别。: Affects protected persons in Geneva, mainly from Ukraine; the aim is neither to raise nor cut aid but to avoid a difference caused by the status change.
须经州议会通过。联邦层面S身份的最新规则见本站另一篇解读。: Needs the cantonal parliament’s approval. Federal Status S rules are covered in a separate explanation on this site.

日内瓦：2026税年自住房估算租金指数升至127.5点（+1.8%）: Geneva: imputed rental value index rises to 127.5 points for tax year 2026 (+1.8%)

特殊教育和普通学校的现行安排不变。: Current special and regular school arrangements continue.

减税规模、补偿方案和预算程序。: Size of the cut, offsetting measures and budget process.
沃州落实“12%倡议”减税：每年少收2.72亿瑞郎，政府提出削支和增收方案: Vaud implements the “12% initiative” tax cut: CHF 272 million less a year, government proposes savings and extra revenue
选民9月27日通过“12%倡议”，降低州所得税和财富税，自明年起实施，州税收估计: Voters adopted the “12% initiative” on 27 September, lowering cantonal income and wealth tax from next year and cutting cantonal revenue by an estimated CHF 272 million a year. If both parents are entitled and have not named a recipient, the office chooses one until the parents name someone else.

The law says "may", so the family benefits office decides which cases it pays automatically; implementation details have not been published. 债务咨询服务法：有还款困难的消费者可获得独立债务咨询，11月20日生效: Debt counselling act: consumers in payment difficulty get access to independent debt counselling, from 20 November
为转化欧盟新消费信贷指令，德国规定：难以偿还或预计难以偿还债务的消费者，有权获得: Implementing the EU’s new consumer credit directive, Germany provides that consumers who have, or expect, difficulty paying their debts have access to independent debt counselling (professional, legal or psychological support), building on the existing recognised counselling centres. Centres may charge fees, but these must not be an unreasonable burden or profit-making, and must be disclosed in advance.
债务咨询主要由各州和市镇资助的公益机构提供，联邦法律没有明确的“获得咨询”规定。: Debt counselling was mainly provided by non-profit centres funded by states and municipalities, without an explicit federal rule on access.

对象是有债务问题的普通消费者。法律没有规定咨询免费，也没有新增联邦资金或缩短等待: Affects ordinary consumers with debt problems. The law does not make counselling free and adds no federal money or waiting-time rule; whether appointments become faster depends on the states and local centres.

第1—3条权利与收费；第6条：11月20日生效，第4条次日生效。: Sections 1–3 on access and fees; section 6: in force 20 November, section 4 the day after publication.
转化欧盟修订版工业排放指令：大型设施须建环境管理体系，违规可罚年营业额3%，受害: Revised EU industrial emissions directive transposed: large installations need environmental management, fines up to 3% of turnover, victims can claim damages
联邦法律修改《联邦排放控制法》《水资源法》《循环经济法》《联邦采矿法》等，转化欧: The federal act amends the Federal Immission Control Act, the Water Resources Act, the Circular Economy Act, the Federal Mining Act and others to transpose EU Directive 2024/1785. Key points: operators of installations under the industrial emissions directive must set up and maintain an environmental management system; for companies with annual turnover above EUR 1.67 million, certain breaches can be fined up to 3% of the previous year’s EU turnover; an operator whose breach harms another person’s health must pay compensation, with a three-year limitation period.
原工业排放规则无普遍的环境管理体系义务，罚款按一般违规罚款上限计算，也没有专门针: The previous rules had no general environmental-management duty, fines followed the ordinary maximums, and there was no specific health-damage compensation clause.
主体部分10月21日生效；部分条款2028年1月1日生效；锻造、电池制造等新增行: Most provisions took effect on 21 October; some on 1 January 2028; provisions for newly covered activities such as forging and battery manufacturing take effect when the EU publishes the relevant best-available-techniques conclusions, at the latest on 1 September 2034.
主要影响大型工业和废物处理设施运营者。居民的直接变化是：如能证明运营者违反义务导: Mainly affects operators of large industrial and waste installations. For residents, the direct change is a damages claim if they can show an operator’s breach harmed their health; the three-year period runs from the end of the year in which they knew (or should have known).
本站只核读了生效条款、罚款和赔偿条款，未逐条解读约50页的技术修改（如畜牧业、许: We read the commencement, fine and compensation provisions only, not every technical change in the roughly 50 pages (for example livestock or permit procedures). Specific installation duties follow the full text and later regulations.

竞技体育资助法：设立莱比锡竞技体育署，2029年起受资助协会须执行“安全体育”准: Elite sport funding act: elite sport agency set up in Leipzig; funded federations must apply the Safe Sport Code from 2029
联邦首次以法律规范竞技体育资助：设立总部在莱比锡的联邦基金会“竞技体育署”（Sp: For the first time a federal law governs elite-sport funding. It creates a federal foundation, the Spitzensport-Agentur, based in Leipzig, to which the Chancellery can transfer funding tasks. Federations must apply the national anti-doping code, act against physical, psychological and sexualised violence, and be properly managed to receive money. Athletes can be supported for living costs, vocational training and pensions. There is no legal entitlement; funding is discretionary within the budget.
联邦竞技体育资助按预算和行政规则发放，没有专门法律和独立机构。: Federal elite-sport funding was paid under budget and administrative rules, without a dedicated act or agency.
资助目标、条件和机构写入法律；违反条件可撤回资助。要求执行“安全体育准则”（Sa: Funding goals, conditions and the agency are set in law; grants can be revoked if conditions are not met. The requirement to apply the Safe Sport Code takes effect on 1 January 2029; the rest took effect on 21 October.
影响联邦体育协会、受资助运动员和教练。对普通居民没有直接义务或费用。: Affects federal sports federations and funded athletes and coaches. No direct duties or costs for ordinary residents.
法律不规定具体资助金额，金额由年度联邦预算决定；竞技体育署何时接手哪些资助领域由: The act sets no funding amounts; these depend on the annual federal budget. Which areas the agency takes over and when depends on later transfers.
“安全体育准则”资助条件生效: Safe Sport Code funding condition takes effect
第3—5条资助原则和条件、第12条设立机构、第29条生效。: Sections 3–5 on principles and conditions, section 12 on the agency, section 29 on commencement.
能源市场主数据登记：电网运营方须登记“技术位置”，个人可用纸质表格登记: Energy market master data register: grid operators register "technical locations"; individuals may register on paper forms

新条例细化《法院组织法》第186条：在法院程序、刑事侦查和执行程序中，有听力或语: The new regulation details section 186 of the Courts Constitution Act: in court, criminal investigation and enforcement proceedings, people with hearing or speech impairments are entitled to necessary and suitable communication aids — for example sign-language or speech-to-text interpreters, lip-speaking interpreters, deafblind assistants, a trusted person, tactile signing or technical aids. 影响作为当事人、证人或被告参加程序的听力或语言障碍者。费用由国家承担（按条例报酬: Affects people with hearing or speech impairments involved as parties, witnesses or defendants. Helpers are paid under the regulation’s rules; it does not require the person to pay.

这是劳动局内部为其公务员养老金预留资金的比例，不改变失业保险缴费率，也不改变任何: This is the agency’s internal reserve rate for its civil servants’ pensions. It changes neither unemployment insurance contributions nor anyone’s pension.

可在该中心递交申请。: Filings could be lodged at this centre.

目录、第5—6条和生效条款。: Table of contents, sections 5–6 and commencement.

影响2027年8月起开始培训的农业学徒及其培训企业。7月31日前已开始、尚未参加: Affects agricultural apprentices starting from August 2027 and their training farms. Apprentices who started before 31 July and have not taken the intermediate exam can switch to the new rules by agreement, keeping the time already completed.
与之配套的职业学校框架教学计划在联邦公报另行公布，本站未核读。: The matching vocational-school curriculum is published separately in the Federal Gazette and was not read.

When a flight booked through an intermediary such as a travel website is cancelled, passengers are entitled to a full refund including the intermediary’s fee, and intermediaries must explain the refund arrangements at booking. Standard refund and compensation claim forms will exist in all languages for all modes of transport, and a person with reduced mobility who needs an accompanying person can have them fly free of charge.

德国《公海保护法》10月22日生效：在国家管辖范围以外海域采集海洋遗传资源须提前: Germany’s High Seas Protection Act in force from 22 October: advance notice for collecting marine genetic resources beyond national jurisdiction, and permits for activities with significant effects
涉及在公海和国际海底区域（各国管辖范围以外的海域）开展科研、采样或其他活动的德国: Affects German institutions, companies, residents and German-flagged ships carrying out research, sampling or other activities on the high seas and the international seabed, the areas beyond any state’s jurisdiction. The UN agreement on marine biodiversity of areas beyond national jurisdiction (BBNJ) entered into force for Germany on 22 October, and so did Germany’s implementing law. Collecting marine genetic resources generally requires notice six months in advance, and a report to the Federal Agency for Nature Conservation within 11 months after collection, including where samples are kept. Activities that may have more than minor or transitory effects on the marine environment, or whose effects are unknown, need a permit and an environmental impact assessment.
该法已于2026年4月29日公布（BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 117），但: The Act was published on 29 April 2026 (BGBl. 2026 I No. 117), but under its section 24 it only takes effect when the agreement enters into force for Germany. Until then, these notice and permit duties did not apply.

Hypothetical example: a German university plans to collect deep-sea microbes on the Atlantic high seas in May 2027. It should give notice around November 2026 (six months ahead, or as early as possible), and report where the samples are kept to the Federal Agency for Nature Conservation within 11 months after collection.

Shipping governed by International Maritime Organization rules, and activities already approved under an equivalent assessment, need no permit (sections 3, 4 and 13). The environment ministry may define by ordinance what counts as a minor or transitory effect; this site has not seen such an ordinance. 电池须可由用户自行更换的规则：豁免清单扩大，智能手表等可穿戴设备、电动玩具等可只: User-replaceable battery rule: more exemptions, so wearables such as smartwatches, electric toys and others may have batteries replaced only by professionals
欧盟电池条例第11条规定，从2027年2月18日起，内置便携式电池的产品原则上必: Under Article 11 of the EU Batteries Regulation, from 18 February 2027 products with built-in portable batteries must in principle let users remove and replace the battery themselves with commercially available tools. Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1770 widens the exceptions where the battery may be replaceable only by independent professionals. Besides appliances used in wet environments, it adds wearable devices, electric toys (until 31 July 2030), wireless food thermometer probes, products for potentially explosive atmospheres, on-body systems that inject medicines under the skin, and roof-mounted telematics devices on agricultural and construction machinery. The regulation enters into force on 11 November 2026.
条例原文第11条第2款只有两类豁免：主要在潮湿环境使用、可清洗的电器；专业医学影: The original Article 11(2) had two exemptions only: appliances designed mainly for wet environments that are washable, and professional medical imaging, radiotherapy and in vitro diagnostic devices.
豁免扩至8类（见规则）。除专业医疗器械外，其余各类只有在为保障使用者和设备安全确: The exemptions grow to eight categories (see the rules). Except for the professional medical devices, each applies only where it is needed for the safety of the user and the appliance.
举例（假设）：2027年3月上市的一款普通蓝牙音箱，原则上必须让用户自己用市售工: Hypothetical example: an ordinary Bluetooth speaker placed on the market in March 2027 must in principle let users replace the battery with commercially available tools. A very small smartwatch that relies on a sealed enclosure against water and dust may be designed so that only professional repairers replace the battery. Products placed on the market before 18 February 2027 are not subject to Article 11.
手机和平板另受生态设计条例(EU) 2023/1670约束。委员会同日公布的第1: Phones and tablets are also covered by Ecodesign Regulation (EU) 2023/1670. The Commission’s Article 11 guidelines published the same day are not legally binding; the Court of Justice has the final word. Whether an exemption applies is decided case by case. This site read the full delegated regulation and the guidelines’ parts on application dates and definitions, not every example in the guidelines.

欧盟解除对匈牙利的“法治条件”预算措施：三项凝聚政策计划55%承诺资金暂停和“公: EU lifts the rule-of-law conditionality measures against Hungary: suspension of 55% of commitments in three cohesion programmes and the ban on contracts with public interest trusts end
理事会10月13日通过，10月21日在官方公报公布；按第4条自通知匈牙利之日起生: Adopted by the Council on 13 October and published in the Official Journal on 21 October. Under Article 4 it takes effect on notification to Hungary; the Official Journal gives no notification date.
理事会认定，2022年依据《法治条件条例》对匈牙利采取预算保护措施的条件已不再满: The Council finds that the conditions for the budget-protection measures taken against Hungary in 2022 under the Rule of Law Conditionality Regulation are no longer met. The measures are lifted in full and Decision 2022/2506 is repealed. This ends the suspension of 55% of commitments under three cohesion programmes (environment and energy efficiency, integrated transport, territorial and settlement development); the ban on EU budget funds under direct or indirect management entering into legal commitments with Hungarian public interest trusts and the entities they maintain; and Hungary’s quarterly reporting duty.
2022年12月起：上述三项计划55%的预算承诺暂停；欧盟直接或间接管理的资金不: Since December 2022: 55% of budget commitments under the three programmes were suspended; EU funds under direct or indirect management could not enter into new legal commitments with Hungarian public interest trusts or the entities they maintain; Hungary had to report on its remedial measures every three months.
措施取消、报告义务终止。理事会依据委员会评估，认定匈牙利已落实公益信托法修订、廉: The measures and the reporting duty end. Based on the Commission’s assessment, the Council finds that Hungary has implemented remedial measures including amendments to the public interest trusts law, the Integrity Authority, the anti-corruption framework, a new judicial review procedure and participation in the European Public Prosecutor’s Office.
主要影响匈牙利政府和相关受益机构：被暂停的承诺资金可以重新按规则使用，公益信托举: Mainly affects the Hungarian government and potential beneficiaries: the suspended commitments can again be used under the normal rules, and entities maintained by public interest trusts can again sign agreements under EU programmes managed directly or indirectly. No direct effect on residents of Germany or other countries.
这只涉及《法治条件条例》下的措施。欧盟对匈牙利资金的其他限制（例如凝聚政策的横向: This only concerns the measures under the Rule of Law Conditionality Regulation. 3欧元临时关税自2026年7月1日起适用至2028年7月1日。2欧元处理费的授权: The EUR 3 temporary duty applies from 1 July 2026 until 1 July 2028. Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/2152 setting the EUR 2 handling fee was published in the Official Journal and entered into force on 22 October; Article 2 applies it from 1 November 2026.
从欧盟以外网购寄入、整单货值不超过150欧元的商品，自2026年7月1日起不再免: Goods bought online from outside the EU with a consignment value of up to EUR 150 lost their duty exemption on 1 July 2026 and instead bear a temporary duty of EUR 3 per item until 1 July 2028. In addition, an EU handling fee of EUR 2 per item applies from 1 November 2026, whatever the value: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/2152 was published on 22 October.
2026年7月1日至2028年7月1日：经IOSS申报增值税或经邮政寄送、整单不: From 1 July 2026 to 1 July 2028: consignments of up to EUR 150 declared under IOSS or sent by post bear a temporary duty of EUR 3 per item, whatever their origin (alcohol, perfume and tobacco included). An “item” means goods in one parcel with the same tariff code, description (and origin); one declaration line counts as one item regardless of quantity. In addition, from 1 November 2026 goods sold at a distance to customers in the EU bear an EU handling fee of EUR 2 per item, whatever their value (also above EUR 150), with no end date.
假设示例：从欧盟以外网店买一件外套和两条同款围巾，整单120欧元，申报为两个税则: Hypothetical example: from a non-EU online shop someone buys one coat and two identical scarves for EUR 120 in total, declared on two tariff lines. The temporary duty is 2 × 3 = EUR 6; from 1 November the handling fee adds 2 × 2 = EUR 4, EUR 10 in total. Import VAT comes on top; how the seller or carrier passes these on to the customer is outside these rules.
2欧元处理费由授权法规(EU) 2026/2152确定，按新海关法典第20条只针: The EUR 2 handling fee is set by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/2152 and, under Article 20 of the new Customs Code, only covers goods sold at a distance. The amount reflects customs authorities’ approximate costs; the Commission reports every two years and may adjust it. The EUR 3 temporary duty runs only until 1 July 2028, after which distance-sales goods pay normal duty rates. The Commission assesses trade diversion monthly and may propose a wider scope, and by 1 December 2027 assesses whether to extend the duty. Non-IOSS, non-postal consignments pay ordinary duty rates. Commission guidance is not legally binding; VAT rules are outside this explanation.

Parliament’s position of 22 October wants three years: importers would have until 31 May 2031 to show that contracts concluded or renewed since 4 August 2024 cover only fuel subject to equivalent monitoring, reporting and verification; producers and importers would first report methane intensity by 5 August 2031 instead of 5 August 2029.

社会保障官方公报（BOSS）10月公布2027年数值；确认该数值的部级命令将在2: The Social Security Official Bulletin (BOSS) announced the 2027 values in October; the ministerial order confirming them is due before the end of 2026 and has not yet been published.
涉及在法国领工资的雇员、雇主和领取社保津贴的人。“社保上限”（PASS）不是要交: Affects employees paid in France, employers and people receiving social security benefits. The social security ceiling (PASS) is not an amount anyone pays: it is the maximum annual income counted when calculating some contributions and benefits. For 2027 it is set at EUR 48,900 (2026: EUR 48,060); the monthly ceiling is EUR 4,075 (2026: EUR 4,005) and the daily ceiling EUR 224.
2026年：年48,060欧元，月4,005欧元，日220欧元。: 2026: EUR 48,060 a year, EUR 4,005 a month, EUR 220 a day.
2027年1月1日起（待命令确认）：年48,900欧元、季12,225欧元、月4: From 1 January 2027 (subject to the order): EUR 48,900 a year, EUR 12,225 a quarter, EUR 4,075 a month, EUR 940 a week, EUR 224 a day, EUR 30 an hour; in Mayotte the monthly ceiling is EUR 3,229 (+6.8%).
举例（假设）：月薪税前5,000欧元（年60,000欧元）的雇员，2027年按上: Hypothetical example: an employee earning EUR 5,000 gross a month (EUR 60,000 a year). In 2027 the capped part of the old-age insurance contribution is calculated on at most EUR 48,900; the remaining EUR 11,100 does not count for that part. Contributions calculated on the full salary are unaffected. For people above the ceiling, the 1.74% rise slightly enlarges the base for those capped contributions; it does not cut take-home pay by the same percentage.
数值来自社保官方公报的公告，部级命令尚未公布。上限还用于确定部分津贴的最高额、离: The values come from the Social Security Official Bulletin announcement; the ministerial order is not yet published. The ceiling also caps some benefits and sets thresholds for exempting severance pay, internship allowances and more, each with its own rules; this explanation does not cover them one by one.

法国：10月17—18日骚乱受损商户可申请部分活动补贴，250人以下企业由国家全: France: businesses hit by the 17–18 October riots can use short-time work; the State covers the full cost for firms with fewer than 250 employees
劳动部10月20日宣布的紧急措施；本站读了Service Public的说明，未: Emergency measures announced by the labour ministry on 20 October. This site read the Service Public explanation, not a legal text creating the special full coverage.
因10月17—18日的破坏而停业或减少营业的企业，可以让员工进入“部分活动”（短: Businesses that closed or reduced activity because of the damage of 17–18 October can put employees on short-time work (activité partielle). An employee on EUR 2,500 gross a month receives 60% for that week, and one on the minimum wage receives 100%. The State reimburses the firm in full. 英国：10月30日起工会可依法要求进入工作场所，雇主须在15个工作日内答复: UK: from 30 October unions can request statutory access to workplaces, and employers must respond within 15 working days
落实《2025年就业权利法》：符合条件的工会可向雇主提出进入工作场所（实地进入或: Implements the Employment Rights Act 2025: qualifying unions can ask an employer for access to a workplace, physically or by other means of communicating with workers. Employers must respond within 15 working days, and the parties have 25 working days to negotiate. Without agreement, either can ask the Central Arbitration Committee (CAC) to decide within 55 working days of the request (70 in exceptional cases). Requests must be refused where the employer, with associated employers, has fewer than 21 workers. Penalties for breaching an access agreement are up to GBP 75,000 the first time, GBP 150,000 the second and GBP 500,000 from the third.

美国：稳定币法（GENIUS）2027年1月18日生效——货币监理署10月23日: United States: the stablecoin law (GENIUS) takes effect on 18 January 2027 — on 23 October the Comptroller of the Currency issued the first main final rule and confirmed that date
法律2025年7月18日签署。货币监理署10月23日公布首个主要联邦监管机构最终: The law was signed on 18 July 2025. On 23 October the Comptroller of the Currency published the first final rule from a primary federal stablecoin regulator and confirmed in it that, because 120 days after that rule falls later than 18 January 2027, the law takes effect 18 months after signing, on 18 January 2027. The Federal Reserve, FDIC, NCUA and Treasury section 3 rules were still proposals when checked in this review.
《GENIUS法》为美国支付稳定币（与美元等法定货币挂钩、用于支付的加密代币）建: The GENIUS Act sets up a federal framework for US payment stablecoins (crypto tokens pegged to a currency such as the dollar and used for payments): only approved issuers may issue them, and they must be fully backed by reserves and redeemable. The law takes effect 18 months after signing or 120 days after the primary regulators issue final rules, whichever is earlier. On 23 October the Comptroller of the Currency (which supervises issuers such as national banks and their subsidiaries) issued its final rule and stated that both the law and that rule take effect on 18 January 2027. The rule requires issuers to publish a redemption policy and to redeem no later than two business days after a request; it bans paying holders any form of interest or yield solely for holding, using or keeping the stablecoin; and it bans claiming that a stablecoin is guaranteed by the US government or covered by deposit insurance. The other agencies’ main rules are still being written.
自2027年1月18日起：支付稳定币须由获准发行人发行，并遵守储备、赎回、反洗钱: From 18 January 2027: payment stablecoins must be issued by approved issuers and meet reserve, redemption, anti-money-laundering and sanctions requirements. Issuers under the Comptroller must complete redemption within two business days of a request (they may ask for more time if redemption requests in one day exceed 10% of a brand’s outstanding amount) and may not pay holders interest or yield. From three years after signing (18 July 2028), digital asset service providers may not offer or sell to people in the United States payment stablecoins from issuers that are not approved (foreign issuers have separate conditions).
美国用户：生效后，平台上可提供的稳定币将限于获准发行人或符合条件的外国发行人；2: US users: once in force, the stablecoins platforms can offer will be limited to approved issuers or qualifying foreign issuers; from July 2028 non-compliant stablecoins may be removed from US platforms. Holding a stablecoin is not itself banned. Example (hypothetical): someone asks an issuer supervised by the Comptroller in February 2027 to redeem 1,000 stablecoins for dollars; the issuer must send the money within two business days, but it may not pay that person a monthly “yield” for holding the 1,000 coins.
货币监理署细则只适用于其管辖的发行人；美联储、联邦存款保险公司、全国信用社管理局: The Comptroller’s rule applies only to issuers under its jurisdiction; issuers supervised by the Federal Reserve, FDIC or NCUA and state issuers follow their own rules, which were still proposals when checked and may differ. The presumptions for payments by third parties or affiliates under the yield ban are not set out here in detail. This does not cover the tax treatment of stablecoins.
货币监理署最终规则：实施《GENIUS法》（联邦公报2026年10月23日）: Comptroller of the Currency final rule implementing the GENIUS Act (Federal Register, 23 October 2026)

签署后18个月或主要联邦支付稳定币监管机构发布任何最终细则后120天，以较早者为: 18 months after signing or 120 days after a primary federal payment stablecoin regulator issues any final rule, whichever is earlier; the Comptroller confirmed 18 January 2027.

The law itself (sections 71301–71305 of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act) is already in force or has fixed start years; the proposed rules only set out how it is applied.
保费税收抵免（PTC）是可退还的税收抵免，帮助在医保交易所（Marketplac: The premium tax credit (PTC) is a refundable tax credit that helps people pay premiums for insurance bought on a health insurance exchange (Marketplace); the part paid each month directly towards premiums is the advance credit (APTC). On 15 October Treasury and the IRS published proposed rules implementing the changes made by the 2025 One Big Beautiful Bill Act (which the government calls the “Working Families Tax Cuts”): from tax year 2027, the premiums of family members who are lawfully present but not “eligible aliens” as defined in the law no longer count in the subsidy calculation; from tax year 2026, excess advance credit must be repaid in full with no cap; and from tax year 2028 exchanges must verify eligibility before paying advance credit.
2025纳税年度及以前：多领的预付抵免按收入设有补缴上限；收入低于联邦贫困线10: Up to tax year 2025: repayment of excess advance credit was capped by income; lawfully present people below 100% of the federal poverty line who could not join Medicaid because of their immigration status could also get the credit. Lawfully present non-citizens could generally get the credit.
2026纳税年度起：多领的预付抵免须全额补缴；上述低于贫困线的合法居留者不再自动: From tax year 2026: excess advance credit must be repaid in full; lawfully present people below the poverty line no longer qualify automatically. From tax year 2027: for family members who are lawfully present but not “eligible aliens”, their share of premiums is removed from both the actual premium and the benchmark premium and receives no subsidy. From tax year 2028: coverage not verified in advance by the exchange does not count as a month eligible for the credit (the proposed rules contain an exception for certain special enrollment periods).
影响通过交易所买保险并领取补贴的家庭，尤其是有非公民成员的家庭。举例（假设）：一: This affects households that buy exchange coverage with a subsidy, especially those with non-citizen members. Example (hypothetical): a family of three receives advance credit in 2027 and one member is lawfully present but not an “eligible alien”; that person’s share of the premium is removed from the subsidy calculation and must be paid at full price. Another example (hypothetical): someone underestimated 2026 income and received USD 3,000 too much advance credit; when filing in 2027 the full USD 3,000 must be repaid, whereas previously repayment could stop at a cap.
这是拟议规则，最终内容可能变化；但上述生效年份来自法律本身，不取决于细则是否定稿: These are proposed rules and may change, but the start years above come from the law itself and do not depend on the rules being finalised. Which statuses count as “eligible aliens” is defined in section 36B(e)(2)(B) of the Internal Revenue Code; the proposed rules do not list them and this page has not checked the statute text. On 21 October the IRS added that for section 4041(a) fuel tax arising from highway use of dyed diesel in that period, it will not challenge failures to file, report or keep records, and will not require later filing or reconstruction of records. From 10 October 2026, textiles and leather in clothing and accessories for the general public, footwear for the general public, paper and cardboard in contact with food, mixtures for the general public (such as sprays and cleaners) and cosmetics may not be placed on the market or used if they reach the limits. 自2026年10月10日起，这五类产品中PFHxA及其盐合计达到25 ppb、或: From 10 October 2026, these five product groups may not be placed on the market or used if the sum of PFHxA and its salts reaches 25 ppb, or the sum of PFHxA-related substances reaches 1,000 ppb, measured in homogeneous material. Next: from 10 October 2027 the same limits extend to other textiles, leather and fur for the general public (uses other than clothing and accessories); from 10 October 2029 they apply to firefighting foams for civil aviation, including civilian airports.

电动滑板车事故：10月1日起车主须承担无过错责任: E-scooter accidents: owners are liable regardless of fault from 1 October
涉及电动滑板车（E-Scooter）的车主（包括租赁公司），以及在事故中受伤的行: Affects owners of e-scooters (including rental companies) and pedestrians, cyclists and others injured in accidents. For accidents from 1 October 2026, injured people can claim compensation from the e-scooter’s owner without proving that the rider was at fault. Until then, e-scooters were exempt from this “keeper liability” because they cannot go faster than 20 km/h.
《道路交通法》第8条第1项：能在平路上行驶的最高时速不超过20公里的机动车造成事: Section 8 no. 1 Road Traffic Act: keeper liability without fault under section 7 does not apply to accidents caused by motor vehicles that cannot exceed 20 km/h on level ground. E-scooters fell into this group, so injured people usually had to prove the rider’s fault to obtain compensation.
电动滑板车（《小型电动车辆条例》第1条第1款所指车辆）不再属于这一例外：车主对车: E-scooters (vehicles under section 1(1) of the Small Electric Vehicles Ordinance) are no longer covered by the exemption: the owner is liable under section 7 for injury and damage caused while the vehicle is in operation, regardless of fault. Accidents before 1 October 2026 remain under the old rule.
举例（假设）：11月，一辆租赁电动滑板车撞伤行人。行人可以向车主即租赁公司索赔，: Hypothetical example: in November a rental e-scooter injures a pedestrian. The pedestrian can claim from the owner, the rental company, without first proving that the rider broke a rule or was careless. Riders get no new obligations; e-scooters already need liability insurance and an insurance plate.
第7条的其他例外（例如不可抗力）和车主责任的赔偿上限没有因本法改变，本站没有逐条: Other exceptions in section 7 (such as force majeure) and the liability caps for keepers are unchanged by this Act and were not read in detail here. The Act changes liability only, not riding rules such as age limits or where e-scooters may be ridden.

After a purchase contract is signed, the notary must report the transaction to the tax office within two weeks. From 1 October this report goes through the designated electronic interface in the official data format, with a text-searchable PDF copy of the deed; the data must also include what is needed for the clearance certificate (Unbedenklichkeitsbescheinigung), which the buyer needs, after paying the real estate transfer tax, to be entered in the land register.

买卖双方不需要自己操作，税率和纳税期限都不变。按《土地购置税法》第22a条，无异: Buyers and sellers do not need to do anything themselves, and tax rates and payment deadlines are unchanged. Under section 22a of the Act, electronic issue of the clearance certificate is governed separately and applies from 1 January 2028.

It was signed on 5 March, the European Parliament consented on 16 September, the Council approved it on 1 October, and it was published in the Official Journal on 26 October.

新《联邦警察法》10月28日生效：经法院批准可在监控中实时比对特定人员，并获反无: New Federal Police Act in force on 28 October: court-approved real-time matching of specific people in video surveillance, drone defence and other powers
涉及在火车站、机场、边境等联邦警察负责区域出行的人，以及被警方视为可能实施重大犯: Affects people travelling in areas policed by the Federal Police, such as railway stations, airports and borders, and people the police consider likely to commit serious crimes. The Federal Police Act has been rewritten and takes effect on 28 October. Main provisions: with court approval, video surveillance can be matched in real time against biometric templates of specific people (up to 72 hours per order); software may automatically detect weapons, suspicious movement patterns or people needing help in camera images, but may not identify people this way; officers may wear body cameras; dangerous drones may be intercepted; and communications may be monitored covertly under certain conditions.
原《联邦警察法》为1994年版本。本站没有逐条比对旧法，以下只说明新法的规定，不: The previous Federal Police Act dated from 1994. It was not compared section by section in this review; what follows describes the new Act and does not claim that each power is new.
实时生物识别比对（第31b条）：只能针对法律列明的人，例如对国家安全或他人生命构: Real-time biometric matching (section 31b): only against people listed in the Act, such as those posing an urgent danger to state security or to someone’s life, people likely to commit terrorist offences, victims of kidnapping or trafficking, and missing persons at risk of death; a court order is required, up to 72 hours at a time and renewable; the system may read only live images, not stored recordings; every suggested match must be checked separately by two officers trained in the risks of artificial intelligence, and data on people who turn out not to be the person sought may not be stored. Automated detection (section 31a): only movement patterns, weapons or dangerous objects and people needing help; identifying people from biometric data is prohibited. Body cameras (section 32): worn openly in public places, police vehicles and certain areas of police stations, not in homes; standby buffering of at most 30 seconds, recordings normally kept 30 days. Drone defence (section 39): where other means fail, measures against a drone or its control link, including weapons.
对普通乘客：在车站、机场等地，联邦警察的视频画面可能被软件自动分析，但这种分析不: For ordinary travellers: at stations, airports and similar places, Federal Police camera images may be analysed automatically, but this analysis may not identify anyone; real-time face matching is limited to specific people approved by a court. People the police consider likely to commit serious crimes can be ordered to report to a police station regularly (up to one month at a time, with court approval for extensions) or banned from a place (up to three months).
法律第1条共107条，本站只读了上述条文和生效条款，没有读立法理由。实时比对和自: Article 1 has 107 sections; this review read only the sections above and the commencement clause, not the explanatory memorandum. The Act does not say when real-time matching or automated detection will actually be used; it requires a scientific evaluation starting two years after a system goes into operation (section 106) and reports to the Bundestag on covert measures every two years, the first by 1 October 2028.
10月22日签署，10月27日公布。: Signed on 22 October, published on 27 October.

欧盟修订社会保障协调规则：跨境失业金、长期护理和外派规则2028年11月起改变: EU revises social security coordination: rules on cross-border unemployment benefits, long-term care and posting change from November 2028
涉及在不同欧盟国家之间工作、居住或领取福利的人，例如住在德国、在邻国上班的跨境通: Affects people who work, live or receive benefits across EU countries, such as cross-border commuters living in Germany and working in a neighbouring country, and employees sent to work in another country. The amending regulation was published on 27 October and enters into force on 1 November, but the main substantive rules apply only from 2 November 2028: wholly unemployed cross-border workers are in principle paid by the country where they last worked, unemployment benefits can be taken abroad for longer while job-seeking, long-term care benefits get their own rules, and people recruited to be posted abroad must first have been insured for at least three months.
现行规则（第883/2004号条例）：完全失业的跨境通勤者通常由居住国发放失业金: Current rules (Regulation 883/2004): wholly unemployed cross-border workers are usually paid by their country of residence; unemployed people looking for work in another EU country can keep their benefits for three months, extendable to at most six; long-term care benefits have no separate rules and are coordinated as sickness benefits.
2028年11月2日起：①完全失业的跨境通勤者原则上按最后工作国法律、由该国机构: From 2 November 2028: (1) wholly unemployed cross-border workers are in principle paid under the law and by the institution of the country of last work; if they were insured there for less than 22 uninterrupted weeks, their country of residence still pays; (2) other unemployed people with less than one uninterrupted month of insurance in the country of last work are the responsibility of the previous country of work; (3) benefits can be exported for six months while job-seeking, extendable by the paying country to the end of entitlement; (4) long-term care benefits get their own definition and remain in principle coordinated as sickness benefits; (5) people recruited to be posted abroad must have been insured for at least three months in the employer’s country beforehand. Some administrative provisions (annex updates, data exchange) apply from 1 November 2026.
举例（假设）：一名住在德国、在荷兰全职工作3年的人，2029年完全失业。按现行规: Hypothetical example: someone living in Germany who has worked full time in the Netherlands for three years becomes wholly unemployed in 2029. Under the current rules they would usually claim German unemployment benefit from the German employment agency; under the new rules, having been insured in the Netherlands for more than 22 weeks, they are in principle paid under Dutch law by the Dutch institution. Had they worked in the Netherlands for only 15 weeks, Germany would still pay. The current rules stay in place until November 2028.

欧盟调整建筑和交通碳市场的稳定储备：配额偏紧时更早、更多投放: EU adjusts the stability reserve of the buildings and transport carbon market to release more allowances sooner when supply is tight
间接涉及用燃气、燃油取暖的家庭和开车的人。欧盟为建筑、道路交通等领域设立单独的碳: Indirectly affects households heating with gas or oil and drivers. The EU is setting up a separate emissions trading system (ETS2) for buildings, road transport and other sectors, in which fuel suppliers must buy allowances for emissions, a cost that may be passed on to fuel and heating prices. The decision published on 28 October changes this market’s stability reserve to dampen sharp price swings in its first years; it enters into force on 17 November.
储备中未投放的配额原定2030年底后失效；流通配额在2.1亿至2.6亿之间时没有: Unreleased allowances in the reserve were due to lapse after 2030; there was no additional release when allowances in circulation were between 210 and 260 million; when the price-stability mechanism was triggered, only the set volume was released.
①储备中未投放的配额2030年后继续有效；②某年流通配额在2.1亿至2.6亿之间: (1) Unreleased allowances remain valid after 2030; (2) in a year when allowances in circulation are between 210 and 260 million, an additional amount of 100 million minus twice the difference between circulation and 210 million is released from 1 September; (3) when the price-stability mechanism (Article 30h(2) of Directive 2003/87/EC) is triggered, 20 million more allowances are released, spread evenly over three months.
Worked example (hypothetical): with 230 million allowances in circulation, the additional release is 100 million − 2 × (230 − 210) million = 60 million. More supply helps restrain prices, but the decision sets no price cap and gives no basis for calculating fuel or heating costs. Germany currently has its own national fuel CO2 price (proposed at EUR 55–65 per tonne for 2027; see the related German explanation).

截至10月28日：草案条款7月13日公布，预算案确认将写入2026—27财政法案: As of 28 October: draft clauses were published on 13 July and the Budget confirms they will go into the Finance Bill 2026–27; not yet law.
涉及在英国持有或使用稳定币的人和企业。税务海关总署拟把“合格稳定币”（与某种法定: Affects people and businesses holding or using stablecoins in the UK. HMRC plans to tax “eligible stablecoins” (cryptoassets that keep a stable value against a fiat currency, backed by fiat or other assets, widely available and designed for payments) like money: disposals by individuals and trustees no longer give rise to capital gains; interest-like returns from lending them are taxed as savings interest; companies are taxed on their accounts. 现行：稳定币与其他加密资产一样，每次处置（卖出或换成其他资产）都可能产生资本利得: Currently stablecoins are treated like other cryptoassets: each disposal (sale or swap) can produce a capital gain or loss.

涉及现在和将来的英国国家养老金领取者。现行“三重锁”规定国家养老金每年按物价上涨: Affects current and future UK State Pension recipients. The government says this continues to April 2029; from April 2030 the pension will rise by the highest of 2.5%, inflation, or the increase needed to keep its value relative to earnings at the April 2029 level, so it tracks earnings over time and no longer ratchets up relative to wages.
